companies.name: Menza
companies.one_liner: The AI data analyst for consumer brands
companies.long_description: Menza is the AI data analyst for consumer brands. A brand like Hershey’s would connect all of their data sources and then we give them an AI analyst that works 24/7 looking for revenue opportunities, cost leaks, trends and anomalies.

companies.name: Bidflow
companies.one_liner: AI Takeoffs for Electrical
companies.long_description: We use AI to help electricians speed up the time it takes to submit a competitive bid to a job. We do this by scanning complex CAD drawings and 10X-ing the time it takes to estimate a job. This involves using vision models to read and count complex symbols in large PDFs, which typically take hours (sometimes days) to do precisely. Every missed symbol can cost thousands, and our AI can count to 99% accuracy.

companies.name: GRU Space
companies.one_liner: Moon Hotel -> The Intergalactic Construction Company of Earth
companies.long_description:
GRU Space is building permanent lunar infrastructure to make humanity interplanetary within our lifetime, starting with the first hotel on the Moon. In just 6 weeks, we built the world's first Moon factory: patent-pending hardware that turns lunar regolith into bricks and inflates modular pressurized habitats designed to withstand lunar temperature and pressure extremes. 

Our first mission lands on the Moon in 2027 to demonstrate in-situ brick manufacturing and habitat deployment. A second mission lays the hotel's foundation inside a lunar cave, and a third opens the first lunar hotel, targeted for 2032. 

We don’t stop at Moon hotels. GRU’s long-term plan:

1. Build the first hotel on the Moon. GRU solves off‑world surface habitation.
2. Become the Moon Base Company of America: build roads, mass drivers, warehouses, and physical infrastructure.
3. Repeat on Mars and build the first cities there.
4. Own property on the Moon and Mars as these economies grow.
5. Reinvest profits into resource utilization systems on the Moon, Mars, asteroids, and beyond—reaching our final form: Galactic Resource Utilization.

GRU Space is backed by investors in SpaceX and Anduril, is part of Nvidia's Inception program, and our launch generated 1B+ views across 60+ countries, earning invitations to the White House, Senate, and Pentagon.

companies.name: Signals
companies.one_liner: iMessage revenue channel for DTC brands that brings customers back
companies.long_description: Signals is a new iMessage revenue channel for DTC ecommerce brands that gets customers to buy again. After a purchase, we open a real two-way conversation over iMessage, the channel customers actually read and reply to, and turn it into repeat revenue. In A/B tests, that drives ~$30 in average incremental repeat revenue per conversation.

companies.name: Overdrive Health
companies.one_liner: AI-Native Medical Billing Services
companies.long_description: Overdrive Health offers AI powered medical billing services, helping providers get paid more money in less time. Our technology enables us to provide the best quality insurance and patient billing services for a fraction of the usual cost

companies.name: Autumn
companies.one_liner: The people-intelligence company.
companies.long_description:
Autumn builds research agents that answer questions about people and companies at scale. These AI agents are powered by a live index of over 1 billion people, 100 million companies, and state-of-the-art web research tools. Autumn is already in production with enterprise teams at Brex, Rippling, PostHog across sourcing, enrichment, and identity-verification workflows.

We are a small, highly-technical team. Our vision is to be the search engine that agents use when they need to understand people, their networks, and professional lives.

companies.name: Pollen
companies.one_liner: AI employees trained on your firm's workflows.
companies.long_description: Pollen gives firms an AI employee trained on their exact workflows.

companies.name: Button Computer
companies.one_liner: The tiny computer built for voice AI.
companies.long_description: We’re launching a small hardware device: a button that you clip to your shirt. You press it to talk to AI, and it responds instantly.

companies.name: Alt-X
companies.one_liner: Building the best venue for private markets exposure.
companies.long_description:
Alt-X is building the AI-native liquidity layer for private markets.

Private markets have created trillions of dollars in value, yet remain fragmented, illiquid, and inaccessible. While public markets benefit from exchanges, market makers, brokerages, and data infrastructure, private markets still rely on brokers, spreadsheets, and manual workflows to connect buyers and sellers.

Alt-X uses AI to automate the core functions required to make private assets liquid. We streamline diligence, valuation, investor matching, and transaction execution, reducing the friction that makes private-market transactions slow, expensive, and opaque today.

Our initial focus is venture-backed secondaries. We source opportunities from founders, employees, and early investors while building a network of accredited investors seeking exposure to the world's most valuable private companies. Over time, we believe every private asset—from startup equity to private credit and alternative investments—will require modern liquidity infrastructure.

Building trusted infrastructure for private markets is difficult. Transactions involve complex diligence, fragmented information, transfer restrictions, and significant compliance requirements. Alt-X is focused on creating systems that can support real transactions at scale, not just marketplace listings.

Ryan Samadi (Stanford CS/AI, former Citadel commodities trader) and Michael Wachsman (Cornell CS, infrastructure engineer) are building Alt-X because they believe ownership of innovation should be more liquid, transparent, and accessible. Today, Alt-X has sourced over $1.5 million in transaction opportunities and assembled a network of 40 accredited investors representing hundreds of millions of dollars in investable assets.

Our mission is to democratize ownership of innovation by building the financial infrastructure that private markets have never had.

companies.name: Velum Labs
companies.one_liner: The OS for data quality across any stack
companies.long_description:
Velum is the operating system for data quality. Velum automatically monitors and enforces data quality across a company's data stack, so bad data never reaches dashboards. We turn data quality from a manual task into infrastructure that runs itself.

Data trust you can prove. From the pipeline to the boardroom.

companies.name: Agentic Fabriq
companies.one_liner: The control plane for AI agents.
companies.long_description: Agentic Fabriq helps companies securely manage what AI agents can access and do across business tools, data, and teams. We give each agent an identity, scoped permissions, approval flows, and audit logs, so employees and customer-facing workflows can use agents without relying on shared API keys, overbroad service accounts, or one-off integrations.

companies.name: Captain
companies.one_liner: Self-tuning search for products and files
companies.long_description:
Captain makes product catalogs and complex, multimodal files searchable for customers and AI agents. It syncs files from sources like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive and tunes search to your data and workloads.

Instead of stitching together parsers, embeddings, vector databases, rerankers, and retrieval infrastructure, developers use Captain to power product search and file retrieval through managed APIs.

On evaluated file-search benchmarks, Captain’s tuning improved retrieval accuracy from roughly 78% with standard RAG to over 97%.

Built for complex catalogs and demanding file-search workloads, including regulated and high-stakes applications.

companies.name: Oxus
companies.one_liner: AI-powered automation for internal audit workflows
companies.long_description:
Oxus automates internal audits for pre-IPO and public companies using AI. Companies including leading payroll providers, public biotechs, and social media enterprises work with us to streamline audit workflows and get audits done 10x faster. 

Learn more at: https://www.oxus-ai.com/

companies.name: General Astronautics
companies.one_liner: Superintelligent space Robots
companies.long_description: Autonomous robotics for space operations.

companies.name: Vector Legal
companies.one_liner: A premier AI-native law firm & legal operating system for Startups.
companies.long_description:
A modern solution for Startup legal.

Vector combines premier lawyers/paralegals (averaging 13+ years of experience) + custom-built AI, so our clients get world class startup legal service at a fraction of Big Law rates. See our client testimonials - https://www.vectorlegal.com/testimonials.

Services: fundraise & priced rounds | customer contracts and commercial contracts | international flips | complex formations | grow your team | agentic data rooms | e-signatures | cap table management | legal health checks | mergers & acquisitions | co-founder separations | dissolutions.

companies.name: Voltair
companies.one_liner: Autonomous Drones for Earth Observation
companies.long_description:
Voltair is building the world's first globally distributed network of autonomous drones for Earth observation.

Power utilities are the perfect first customer. Aging infrastructure and extreme weather drive the need for millimeter-scale inspection data on the power grid. Utilities spend tens of billions of dollars every year just looking at their own equipment. Autonomous drone fleets will enable utilities to inspect 7 million miles of infrastructure more frequently, quickly, and accurately. Our long-range, weatherized flying robots work with charging pads installed directly on utility poles. Each new pad unlocks 1000 square miles of coverage.

With a charging network deployed on the power grid, we can serve existing multi-billion dollar data markets in road, rail and telecom inspection at 10x lower prices while enabling entirely new applications in hyperlocal weather monitoring, forestry, construction, search & rescue, and insurance.

We envision a future in which drone "instances" are requested on-demand through our platform, enabling any application builder to serve these critical markets without ever operating their own hardware.

companies.name: Crosslayer Labs
companies.one_liner: Protect, monitor and defend your Internet presence
companies.long_description: Crosslayer Labs detects impersonation attacks on websites and APIs. We provide "outside-in" monitoring of customer infrastructure, comprehensively discovering and monitoring all Internet dependencies, including DNS, BGP, TLS certs, Javascript. We correlate signals from different layers of the Internet stack to identify attack patterns. Our alerts are actionable and contain root cause analysis/remediation recommendations. Our founding team is world renowned for previously inventing the MPIC standard adopted by all the major CAs including Google, Apple, Amazon. The MPIC standard is securing over 700 million websites via the issuance of over 3 billion digital certificates, and is now a global internet standard that protects every single HTTPS connection.

companies.name: Ndea
companies.one_liner: Building AGI that can innovate.
companies.long_description:
Ndea is building frontier AI systems that blend intuitive pattern recognition and formal reasoning into a unified architecture.

# AI for Scientific Advancement

Unlike all life before us, humanity's ascent is a story of ingenuity, not just biological evolution. Our progress has been driven by the curiosity to acquire knowledge, the ability to pass it on, and an intrinsic drive to innovate. We build technology which gives us leverage beyond our biology.

We stand at the top of a knowledge and technology colossus that we collectively created over the past ten thousand generations. Scientific progress has helped us overcome burdens that long defined human life — famines, plagues, and widespread illiteracy. Science will continue to redefine the boundaries of the human condition.

Today, the acceleration of scientific progress hinges on one factor: AI capable of independent invention and discovery. This capacity is the gateway to advancements beyond our wildest imagination.

# A New Research Lab

We're starting Ndea — an AI research and science lab. The name - like 'idea' with an 'n' - is inspired by the Greek concepts ennoia (intuitive understanding) and dianoia (logical reasoning), capturing our first goal to merge deep learning with program synthesis.

Ndea is entirely focused on developing and operationalizing AGI to realize unprecedented scientific progress in our lifetime for the benefit of all current and future generations.

Building AGI alone is a monumental undertaking, but our mission is even bigger. We're creating a factory for rapid scientific advancement — a factory capable of inventing and commercializing N ideas.

From our vantage point today, we see many 'known' frontiers like self-driving vehicles, drug discovery, sustainable energy, robotics, and space exploration. While AGI will benefit all of these, the most exciting adventure lies in the 'unknown'. AGI promises discoveries and progress we cannot imagine today.

companies.name: Standard Physics
companies.one_liner: Fast Physics Simulations for Rapid Design and Real Time Control
companies.long_description:
Standard Physics (formerly Inviscid AI) builds AI that does real physics. Most AI tools approximate physical behavior and get it wrong in ways engineers can’t see. Ours run actual numerical solvers, so the results are accurate enough to make real engineering decisions on.

We have three products built on one engine.

Reynolds runs computational fluid dynamics for you. An engineer describes the flow in plain language, and Reynolds writes the OpenFOAM case, builds the mesh, runs the solver, and returns the figures, the numbers, and a case they can rerun. It’s open source.

Archimedes searches the design itself. Swarms of agents try thousands of layouts in parallel, simulate each one through Reynolds, keep what the physics rewards, and redraw the search space when the best answer was never in the original plan. We sell it as outcome-based engineering: customers pay for a better design, not for compute.

Inviscid AI (now a product!) points the same engine at a running building. It holds a data center within its thermal limits in real time, computed continuously from live telemetry. Our platform optimizes airflow patterns and ventilation strategies to eliminate dead zones, improve air distribution, and reduce the load on mechanical systems. On the energy side, we minimize HVAC power consumption, reduce cooling costs, and lower overall operational expenses while maintaining optimal thermal comfort and indoor air quality. 

We work with hardware startups and engineering teams on data center cooling, drones, energy systems, piping, and electronics. Reynolds earns engineers’ trust in daily use, and Archimedes and Inviscid AI turn that trust into large contracts.

companies.name: ClaimGlide
companies.one_liner: AI automated prior-auths for private medical practices
companies.long_description: We automate the entire end-to-end prior-authorization process for private practices for cheaper, and more accurately than they're doing today.

companies.name: Haladir
companies.one_liner: Operational Intelligence for Global Logistics
companies.long_description: Haladir builds advanced AI systems for logistics. We sit on top of your WMS, TMS and ERP, turning their data into decisions across supply chain planning and execution: solver-grade optimization that decides what should happen, and AI agents that run the workflows. Today's AI brought intelligence. The next frontier is judgement.

companies.name: Mantis
companies.one_liner: Digital Twins of humans
companies.long_description: Mantis is a digital twin company that combines LLMs with high-fidelity physics simulations in order to convert rare and difficult-to-access human behavior data into predictive models.

companies.name: CatchBack Cards
companies.one_liner: The most thrilling way to create and rip digital collectible packs
companies.long_description: CatchBack Cards is a mobile app and website platform for maximizing the thrill of collecting Pokemon and Sports cards. We allow collectors to create custom mystery packs with personalized chases and customized odds with cryptographically trusted tooling. Users can rip open digital packs and get physical cards shipped to them, receive buyback offers on cards pulled from their mystery packs sent straight to Venmo and PayPal, and buy/sell cards in our $1 marketplace.

companies.name: FullSeam
companies.one_liner: AI agents for corporate accounting teams
companies.long_description: FullSeam builds agents for corporate accounting. Our agents replace manual accounting tasks that typically happen outside of our customers’ accounting software, like accounts payable, accounts receivable, and reconciliation.

companies.name: Corvera
companies.one_liner: The AI sales agent for CPG brands
companies.long_description:
Corvera (YC W26) is the AI sales agent for CPG brands. We turn the data a brand already has into the actions its sales team takes today.

A CPG brand sells into tens of thousands of independent US stores through dozens of distributors, and works that base with a handful of people. CLEAN Cause, a $20M yerba mate brand, covers 21,000 stores through 46 distributors with a four-person sales team. The accounts worth a call are not capped by headcount. The team is.

CLEAN Cause now runs its daily sales decisions on Corvera: 5,000 queries in 40 days across 12 users, $250K of opportunities surfaced within days, and a 7x return on the analysts they would otherwise hire.

With Corvera in place, every sales rep starts the morning with:
- The stores to act on today, ranked and priced, with the reason on the row,
- The outreach already drafted to the right contact at the right distributor, and
- The follow-up booked, logged, and measured against the goal it was set to move.

All from the distributor feeds, retailer portals, and ERP data they already have, resolved into one context layer - without a data team, and without handing their sales to a broker.

We’re founded by Chris (2x Founder; ex-CEO at Better Nature; Forbes 30U30), Dirk (ex-Google Data & AI Lead), and Matthew (ex-Head of Product at Rosemark; Princeton MEng in CS).

To date, we’ve raised $6.2M and are backed by YC, firstminute capital, 6 Degrees Capital, 20VC, Rebel Fund, Duke Capital Partners, and more. Our ICP is US CPG brands doing $20M+ in retail revenue through UNFI, KeHE and DSD distributors. We sell to VPs of Sales and CEOs.

The incumbents prove the scale. Brokers take 5-12% of a $350B US independent grocery market, and Advantage Solutions, a publicly traded company, does $3.5B in annual revenue.

Our mission is bold: to enable the next generation of unicorn CPG brands to be run by teams of less than 10 people.

Our vision is even bolder: to give every CPG brand the coverage of a full sales team at a fraction of the headcount, and displace the broker network that covers the US independent channel today.

Visit www.corvera.ai to learn more!

companies.name: ARC Prize Foundation
companies.one_liner: AI benchmarks that measure general intelligence and inspire new ideas
companies.long_description:
ARC Prize builds AI benchmarks that measure general intelligence. Our benchmark, ARC-AGI, has been used by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and xAI.

Founded by Mike Knoop and Francois Chollet, we inspire open source artificial general intelligence (AGI) research through benchmarks (the ARC-AGI series), global competitions, research grants, community, and content, we exist to guide researchers, industry, and regulators on the path to AGI.

We believe that AGI requires more than just scaling up existing AI models. It demands a fundamental shift towards systems capable of genuine fluid intelligence, the ability to adapt to novel challenges and solve problems efficiently, much like humans do.

companies.name: Valgo
companies.one_liner: Insurance risk layer for physical AI
companies.long_description:
Insurers struggle to price autonomous systems because the historical data simply doesn't exist. Your car insurance draws from over 30 billion claims records, but autonomous trucks and robots have nearly zero. Valgo is the risk quantification platform that closes that gap. We are building probabilistic models of routes, tasks, and environments from the bottom up. We output a simulated loss estimate that insurers need to price coverage. Valgo is the foundational layer that gives insurance providers confidence to properly price autonomy risk.

Our team combines expertise in risk estimation for autonomy with deep experience in the insurance industry. Sydney and Robert are Stanford PhDs with leading expertise in safety of physical AI systems. Sydney wrote the textbook on validating safety-critical systems and teaches the course at Stanford. Robert spent 7 years at MIT Lincoln Laboratory on the core team that designed and validated an FAA-certified aircraft collision avoidance system, now a worldwide standard. Jon is a Sloan Fellow from the Stanford GSB and an actuary who spent over 12 years in insurance leadership and led over $5 billion in M&A as head of corporate development for one of the largest insurers in Asia-Pacific.

companies.name: Eos AI
companies.one_liner: Autonomous OS for healthcare
companies.long_description:
Eos helps clinics turn their data into actionable insights to identify more eligible patients and early care interventions.

We harmonize historical data across all systems to create standardized patient data distributions, acting like a translation layer between different applications. Then we build a centralized index over it: a compressed representation that lets petabytes of raw data stay where it is while allowing us to search and reason across it as one system.

Instead of treating the visit or document as an isolated instance, we can look at it as a continuous story. We can predict how a case will resolve, trigger the required approvals and actions, and do so while reducing staff workload and recovering hospital revenue.

companies.name: Hlabs
companies.one_liner: US-Made Parts for Robots
companies.long_description:
HLabs is making an industrial supply chain for building robots in the USA including electronics and actuators, with a focus on in-house manufacturing.

Robotics is going to be one of the largest industries the world has ever seen. Teams have to buy what they can from overseas and then build everything else in house just to get something to move. HLabs is producing a plug and play set of robotic primitives to accelerate the early development and then working with larger scale production robots for bespoke designs.

Early customers span across household robotics, humanoids, robot arms, quadrupeds, and defense.

Hlabs is founded by Paul, a second time YC founder who also participated in the W21 batch with Mystic. He ran Mystic as CEO for 6 years.

companies.name: Origin
companies.one_liner: AI and Data for Cancer Therapeutics
companies.long_description:
We produce patient-derived cancer datasets for licensing to pharmaceutical and AI companies. Our data comprises matched spatial transcriptomics, H&E and clinical labels. We operate our own laboratory, where samples are processed. Samples are sourced from leading biobank / hospital networks.

As R&D workflows increasingly rely on frontier AI systems, we believe there is critical need for real world datapoints so that findings translate in the clinic.

companies.name: Payna
companies.one_liner: AI Licensing Agent for Regulated Industries
companies.long_description: Payna is building the AI licensing agent for regulated companies. We automate the filings, renewals, amendments, and regulator follow ups required to get licensed and stay licensed across jurisdictions, so teams no longer have to manage compliance through spreadsheets, email threads, and expensive outside firms. Starting with financial services categories like lending, debt collection, and money transmission, Payna helps companies move faster, stay compliant, and scale without adding compliance headcount linearly.

companies.name: Panta
companies.one_liner: AI Native Commercial Insurance Brokerage
companies.long_description: Panta is a technology-enabled commercial insurance brokerage: we combine AI-powered internal workflows with licensed brokers to help businesses secure complex coverage faster than anyone in the world.

companies.name: Didit
companies.one_liner: Infrastructure for identity and fraud.
companies.long_description: One API for KYC, KYB, AML, authentication, biometrics, and fraud — powered by 1,000+ data sources, 200+ signals, and in-house AI models. Global coverage. Integrate in minutes, pay as you go. Start free at business.didit.me.

companies.name: One Robot
companies.one_liner: World models for robot evals and training.
companies.long_description:
One Robot builds simulation environments that are realistic to see and realistic to interact with, so robotics teams can train and evaluate robot policies without being bottlenecked by robot time.

Today, improving a VLA often means more real-world hours: setting up the scene, running trials, resetting, and repeating. This loop is slow, expensive, and hard to scale. For example, material handling and manufacturing assembly tasks, models need far more training and evaluation data than teams can collect in the real world.

We use task-specific data to build world model-based simulation environments for hard manipulation tasks (for example, textiles and box folding). These environments help teams run more training and evals, find failure modes faster, and accelerate iteration on action policies with less dependence on real-world data collection and robot availability.

companies.name: Quotient Labs
companies.one_liner: Use Claude Code at 47% less cost in one line of installation.
companies.long_description:
You should only be paying frontier model prices for top-shelf reasoning. But 88% of your token bill is just tool I/O.
 Quotient Labs runs on top of Claude Code to reduce token spend, compress context, and optimize tool calls while preserving output quality. Same models, same workflow, no changes to how you work. Benchmarked 47% less cost on real, multi-step developer workflows, with no quality loss.

companies.name: Kita
companies.one_liner: Underwrite borrowers around the world in minutes
companies.long_description:
In emerging markets, open finance is still nascent. Most of the population is traditionally unbanked, banking APIs don’t exist, and a borrower’s financial history lives in documents: e-wallet records, bank statements, utility bills, and more. Because this data is unstructured, credit and risk teams are forced into manual review. This slows decisioning, increases costs, and caps lending volume. 

Kita is the AI platform for global lending operations. We help lenders in emerging markets automate application completion, document verification, and underwriting from messy financial documents — using AI to extract fraud-checked data and localized risk signals that power faster, better credit decisions.

Under the hood, Kita is a learning engine. We link document-level signals to repayment outcomes, allowing our models to continuously improve fraud detection and risk assessment over time. This creates a compounding advantage for lenders as their distinct underwriting decisions feed back into the system.

We’re Carmel and Rhea. We met before Stanford and have been building together ever since. Carmel is from Manila, is a repeat founder, and spent three years in product at Apple. Rhea has a research background in computer vision and received the highest honor in Stanford Computer Science. Together, we combine deep local context with strong technical execution to build the infrastructure that expands access to credit in emerging markets.

companies.name: Klaus AI
companies.one_liner: Fast and Safe OpenClaw on the cloud
companies.long_description: Get your personal OpenClaw instance on the cloud and connected to your Slack or other messaging app in 3 minutes. Pre-installed security features and common skills.

companies.name: Janeen
companies.one_liner: Prior auths and benefits investigation for infusion clinics
companies.long_description:
Janeen is built for infusion clinics. We handle prior authorizations and benefit investigations from start to finish (actually though!).

Biologics are expensive medications that cost $80-$150K+ per year per patient, and often need to be administered in specific settings called infusion clinics. Medical providers buy these drugs up front to secure pricing deals and safer inventory - they are reimbursed for the cost of the medications through the patients’ insurance. 

Current medical workflows aren't built for infusion clinics. Inventory, storage, transport, and billing is still managed through paper and excel spreadsheets. And because they’re so expensive, these specialty medications are denied by insurers at a rate of 37% each year. When they are denied, when workflows fail, or patients are infused before paperwork is cleared, providers don’t get reimbursed for the medication and are left covering the costs. Ruma Care solves this so clinics get paid, patients get treated faster, and care teams spend less time fighting forms. 

We work with clinics across the country and have removed 95% of all manual labor in the process.

companies.name: Lucent
companies.one_liner: AI that automatically improves products from user behavior
companies.long_description: Lucent is an AI product manager that automatically improves products based on how users behave. We use AI to watch and understand user sessions and detect bugs and UX issues.

companies.name: RunAnywhere
companies.one_liner: Fastest inference anywhere: open models on-prem, hosted or on-device
companies.long_description: RunAnywhere runs open-weight models at full speed wherever a company needs them. Wally is our inference stack for open models: serverless inference, BYOC, or on-prem, so code and data never leave their network. One command puts a Wally-served model inside Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, etc. When a model fits on the device, the same tooling runs it locally through our open-source SDKs for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and web, built on kernels written by our agentic harness for Apple and Qualcomm silicon (10K+ GitHub stars).

companies.name: Lance
companies.one_liner: AI Agents That Run Hotel Operations.
companies.long_description:
Autonomous AI agents that answer calls, close sales, and run operations, so your team can focus on guests. Trusted by some of the top hotel groups in the US, supporting 50+ hotels across brands like Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt

Built on advanced Computer Use Agent technology, Lance agents can navigate your existing hotel software, make real-time decisions, and handle complex multi-step tasks.

companies.name: Docura Health
companies.one_liner: AI-Native Med-Legal Firm
companies.long_description: Docura Health reduces settlement time in workers’ compensation cases by automating medical record review, chronologies, and report drafting with AI. We transform thousands of pages of records into structured, compliant summaries, helping evaluators, claim adjusters, insurers, and legal teams resolve cases faster.

companies.name: Mirabelle
companies.one_liner: Your own chef at home
companies.long_description:
We build the personal robot chef.

Mirabelle cooks fresh meals on demand, so you can eat well every day without spending hours in the kitchen.

companies.name: Axis
companies.one_liner: An AI Copilot for Trading Desks
companies.long_description:
Axis is building an AI Native Trading System, allowing a trader to deploy models that monitor and analyze relevant markets and strategies. We've chosen commodities as our first market.
Commodities make up a third of global goods exports, and physical commodities traders decide the movement and storage of metals, agricultural products, and energy across the globe. They trade in public markets and bilateral OTC agreements. Engaging in these markets is complexing, covering derivatives positioning, refinery data, storage inventory, import/exports, geopolitical events and more. Axis is building an AI driven analytical layer for these markets.

companies.name: Lexius
companies.one_liner: AI for Corporate Security Cameras
companies.long_description:
Lexius turns existing security cameras into an AI security guard that detects, documents, and alerts incidents like shoplifting and slip-and-falls.

Millions of locations already have cameras but no intelligence. Replacing them costs $50K to $100K per site. Lexius upgrades every camera instantly, no rip and replace, no new hardware.

Real-world camera systems are messy, fragmented, and decades old, and AI breaks on low-quality CCTV. The hard part isn’t the model, it’s making unreliable systems work at scale with accuracy high enough for real decisions.

Lexius starts with security and liability, and becomes the operating system for physical spaces.

companies.name: Asimov
companies.one_liner: Real-world human movement data for humanoid robots
companies.long_description: Asimov collects real-world human movement data from households and businesses to train humanoid robots. Unlike factory datasets that capture the same tasks in the same environments, we deliver the full diversity of real human environments, thousands of hours a day to leading labs.

companies.name: shortkit
companies.one_liner: Media infra for consumer apps
companies.long_description:
ShortKit lets any consumer app launch a TikTok-grade media expereinces. 

Michael, spent 6 years at YouTube building the infrastructure that powers YouTube Shorts. Neil, prev. scaled a SaaS company from 0 to $6M ARR as employee #1. 

We handle the full media stack, starting with short form video - client SDKs, video infrastructure, rec systems, and monetization - so product teams don't have to.

companies.name: REV1
companies.one_liner: Claude Code for Mechanical Engineers
companies.long_description:
REV1 is Claude code for mechanical engineers, starting with automating the process of turning 3D designs into 2D manufacturing drawings – which is more than 25% of all of what a mechanical engineer does - our software does it in minutes. 
Compressing hours of work into minutes while delivering consistent, higher quality results.

companies.name: 10x Science
companies.one_liner: The AI-native platform for next-generation protein characterization.
companies.long_description:
10x Science develops frontier AI models with deep memory to redefine how scientists understand and engineer biology across the life sciences, starting with drug development.

AI-powered drug discovery is flooding the pipeline with new candidates faster than ever. But before any of them can advance to the clinic, scientists must deeply characterize the protein therapeutic to understand whether it will work. Today, that process takes months of manual, error-prone analysis that cannot keep pace with discovery. Our AI-native platform automates it, giving drug developers the confidence to advance the right candidates and stop the wrong ones early.

We have strong commercial traction with enterprise pharma customers. Our founding team built the field of next-generation protein characterization out of Carolyn Bertozzi's Nobel laureate lab at Stanford. Collectively, we have 18+ years of collective domain expertise, 47+ scientific publications, and a 2x YC Founder. We move at the highest velocity and are positioned to lead the next generation of modern AI development in the life sciences.

companies.name: Sentrial
companies.one_liner: Datadog for Agent Reliability
companies.long_description:
Sentrial is the monitoring platform for AI products in production. 

When your AI product/agent loops indefinitely, hallucinates, or frustrates users, Sentrial detects it in real-time, diagnoses the root cause, and recommends specific fixes. We provide the monitoring, evaluation, and debugging infrastructure that traditional tools weren't built for, so teams iterate based on production reality, not just offline evals.

companies.name: LegalOS
companies.one_liner: The AI-Native Immigration Law Firm
companies.long_description:
LegalOS is an AI-native immigration law firm that combines cutting-edge technology with 40+ years of legal expertise.

We’ve studied 12,000 successful petitions to design our process - which allows us to deliver top-quality visa applications in as quickly as 48 hours. Our specialized AI agents draft petition narratives, compile evidence, and anticipate USCIS objections - work that traditionally takes attorneys weeks, if not months.

Every case is reviewed and signed by licensed immigration attorneys with 40+ years of experience, so companies get both speed and reliability. We support O-1, H-1B, L-1A, L-1B, TN, EB-1A, EB-1C, and EB-2 NIW petitions.

Our unique approach works. We’ve filed dozens of visa applications and have a 100% approval rate so far.

The U.S. processes 1M+ work visas annually—a market where incumbents still operate on fax machines, email, and 1990s case management software. We're building the modern immigration law firm.

companies.name: Cofia
companies.one_liner: AI automations that implement themselves
companies.long_description: Cofia learns how your team runs internal operations and automates the highest-ROI workflows, automatically.

companies.name: BaseFrame
companies.one_liner: Detect what AI can automate for your team
companies.long_description:
Most teams want to plug in AI but don't know where to get started. BaseFrame's desktop app finds exactly what to automate for each employee using the historic data on their computer. 

Instead of relying on screen recording or generic AI demos, we use the existing history of how work gets done across email, docs, Slack, calendar, browser, and files to identify the highest-value automations. We use local models so that your sensitive data doesn’t have to leave your system. 

Once you find a set of automations, send them off to your automation tool of choice and share them with your team so that everyone can get productivity boosts.

companies.name: Strand AI
companies.one_liner: Multimodal foundation models to predict uncollected patient biology
companies.long_description: Strand AI develops foundation models to generate missing bio-data about patients. With this imputed data, pharmaceutical companies can select better patients for their drug trials and shave months from their drug launch timelines. We’ve already trained a multimodal foundation model that integrates spatial biology modalities, beating SOTA at a fraction of the cost.

companies.name: Beacon Health
companies.one_liner: AI Employees for Primary Care
companies.long_description:
Beacon Health (YC W26) is building AI employees that double revenue for primary care practices while also reducing the total cost of care.

Primary care is the primary source of care for over 200M Americans, but physicians don’t have the bandwidth to manage their patient panels. 

Beacon Health builds AI employees that automate tedious background workflows - preventative screenings, prior authorizations, referrals, and risk adjustment. We handle these workflows from start to finish, directly in their EHR.

We’re on a mission is to bring joy back to primary care.

companies.name: Envariant
companies.one_liner: Interpretability and reasoning infra for foundation models.
companies.long_description: Envariant is an AI interpretability and reasoning SDK enabling foundation model builders to analyze, steer, and control their model's behaviors.

companies.name: Burt
companies.one_liner: AI teammates for logistics
companies.long_description:
We're building for the people that keep the world moving. 

Freight brokers and forwarders operate on razor-thin margins in a relationship-driven business — yet most of their teams spend the majority of their day on manual, repetitive work.

We help freight brokers and forwarders build AI teammates that handle their repetitive, manual tasks so teams have time to focus on customers, carriers, and growing the business.

companies.name: CellType
companies.one_liner: The agentic drug company. We simulate human biology.
companies.long_description: CellType is building an agentic drug company. AI agents that run the full drug discovery pipeline on top of biological foundation models that simulate human biology. Our core technology, developed with Google DeepMind, has already discovered and validated a new cancer treatment signal. We’re working with Top 10 pharma.

companies.name: Piris Labs
companies.one_liner: The Networking Layer of AI
companies.long_description: Up to 80% of the most advance AI compute chips sits idle because of slow networking. Piris Labs builds photonic based networking solutions to enable fast, scalable, and low cost AI workload execution infrastructure.

companies.name: OpenSpec
companies.one_liner: Plan mode for complex features
companies.long_description:
OpenSpec is an open-source, spec-driven framework. We help developers plan complex features by creating lightweight spec documents that serve as durable context for their coding agents.

With 20k+ GitHub stars, we’re one of the leading spec-driven frameworks, used by thousands of developers and teams to plan and ship with the coding agent of their choice.

Our philosophy is simple: keep planning lightweight and iterative, and match how software actually gets built, messy, evolving, and real, without dragging teams into rigid, bureaucratic workflows.

companies.name: /dev/fast
companies.one_liner: /dev/fast is the AI-native code forge
companies.long_description:
/dev/fast is the AI-native code forge. We're building Whiteboard, an open-source canvas for thoughtful software design.

The Whiteboard app is designed to give you confidence in your code. Critique interactive visualizations, diffs, and agent traces, all from one interface. 

Learn more at https://dev.fast

companies.name: ZeroSettle
companies.one_liner: Drop-in Direct Billing SDK for In-App Purchases
companies.long_description: ZeroSettle is a mobile SDK that switches customers from App Store billing to direct billing. It takes 15 minutes to set up and immediately unlocks zero App Store fees, higher retention/conversion, and instant payouts.

companies.name: Kyten Technologies
companies.one_liner: Custom Aerospace-Grade Battery Packs
companies.long_description:
Kyten Technologies is building a factory to manufacture custom aerospace-grade battery packs. 
100,000+ drones, submarines, and satellites are being built in the US, but the legacy supply chain can't keep up. 
During our six years at Starlink, we put 5,000+ battery packs into space. Now, we're bringing rapid development and volume production of aerospace-grade battery packs to the entire industry.

companies.name: Avoice
companies.one_liner: AI-native workspace for AEC
companies.long_description:
Avoice is an all-in-one, AI-native platform for running an architecture practice. It covers the whole arc of a project: pricing and proposals to win the work, research and schedules in early design, specifications and QA/QC checks through documentation, contract particulars and preliminaries at tender, then RFIs, submittals, instructions, certificates and valuations through construction, and the compliance record at handover. Timesheets, fees, financials and invoicing run alongside, with Xero and QuickBooks.

Specification is the most-used part of the platform. Avoice drafts coordinated, tender-ready specifications from a practice's own drawings, schedules and office masters, then checks them back against those drawings. Work that normally takes weeks takes an afternoon.

Practices in the UK, US, Australia and New Zealand use Avoice, from boutique studios to firms of several hundred people. It integrates with Revit and ArchiCAD.

companies.name: 21st
companies.one_liner: UI building blocks for the agentic internet
companies.long_description:
21st.dev is the largest React component registry for AI applications, used by 2M developers 
We provide the building blocks to create agent-powered apps: UI components, agent templates.

companies.name: Palus Finance
companies.one_liner: Your startup's financial advisor
companies.long_description:
After a fundraise, you want to focus 100% on scaling your company, but suddenly there's a mountain of finance and ops decisions you need to figure out. Though these tasks feel like distractions, making the wrong decisions here can literally kill your company.

Palus is your startup's financial advisor. We help you with the decisions that come with scaling: where to store your cash, how to think about runway, and how to optimize your company’s finance/ops setup.

Palus will save you dozens of hours on operations work, help you avoid making financial mistakes, and our cash management service can earn you $100s of thousands in extra yield on your fundraise without switching banks or taking on unnecessary risk. And you can reach us 24/7 via Slack.

What makes us an advisor and not another bank or finance tool is that we're an actual fiduciary, not a product with a salesperson attached. Mercury, Rho, and Brex can't legally give you financial advice; they hand you a dashboard and leave the decisions to you. Palus signs an advisory contract with you, giving us a legal fiduciary duty to act in your company’s best interest. This lets us give you actionable financial advice and optimize your cash to best suit your goals and company’s needs.

Sam and Michael are technical cofounders who met at Caltech. Sam previously built the AI research platform for a $3T AUM asset manager; Michael built quantum computers for the defense industry.

companies.name: Tepali
companies.one_liner: AI EMR for medspas & wellness clinics
companies.long_description: Tepali is the AI EMR for medspas & wellness clinics. Front desk, charting, point of sale, and marketing in one system, with an AI employee that books new leads, charts every appointment, and brings past clients back.

companies.name: Cumulus Labs
companies.one_liner: The Fastest Multimodal Inference OS
companies.long_description:
Cumulus Labs lets engineering teams ship AI in production without needing a dedicated ML platform team. Right now, companies building AI products are forced to stitch together separate vendors for routing, observability, evaluation, fine-tuning, and inference. This fragmented approach is brittle, expensive, and is a common reason enterprises fail with AI.  

We replace that entire stack with a single unified platform. Developers can keep their existing code while instantly upgrading to a unified platform that handles routing, semantic caching, continuous shadow evaluation, simulated data, and one-click fine-tuning. 

Behind the platform is Ion, our proprietary inference engine running on a custom NVIDIA Grace GPU fleet. Ion uses in-house custom GPU kernels to deliver 30 to 50 percent more throughput than standard vLLM or SGLang, giving our customers SOTA inference economics.

companies.name: Verdex
companies.one_liner: AI Verification for Insurance
companies.long_description: Verdex is an AI insurance adjuster. We use data streams like satellite imagery to verify claims, allowing insurers to process it immediately and save billions of dollars. We are currently helping insure over 11% of all American farmland.

companies.name: AutoSitu
companies.one_liner: The AI operating system for the built world
companies.long_description:
At AutoSitu, we’re building the AI operating system for the built world—coordinated AI agents that work across development, design, review, and construction.

Our agents analyze complex plans, requirements, and project documentation in minutes—surfacing critical issues, doing the heavy lifting, and escalating the decisions that require human expertise.

From site feasibility and entitlement risk to QA/QC, code compliance, constructability, quantity takeoff, and scope analysis, AutoSitu helps cities, architects, engineers, developers, and construction teams identify problems earlier and move projects forward with greater speed and confidence.

We serve as a strategic AI partner to forward-thinking public agencies and AEC organizations across the country and are backed by Y Combinator (W26).

companies.name: Zatanna
companies.one_liner: Building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software
companies.long_description: Zatanna is building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software. AI agents are increasingly capable of performing work that was previously done by humans, but they're still constrained by software interfaces designed for people. Today, agents rely heavily on clicking buttons, navigating pages, and interacting with UIs to get things done. At Zatanna, we're changing that by reverse engineering applications to turn their underlying workflows and actions into reliable, read-and-write APIs, regardless of whether those applications offer APIs themselves.

companies.name: MouseCat
companies.one_liner: AI to fight financial crime
companies.long_description:
MouseCat enables companies to detect suspicious activity, automate investigations, and act before the money leaves.

We work with Fortune 500 companies and startups to deploy real-time models and AI agents that reduce fraud, compliance incidents, and friction for good customers.

companies.name: Skillsync
companies.one_liner: Search your agent session history
companies.long_description: Skillsync makes your agent session history searchable. Both for you and your coding agents. It searches all your sessions before each prompt and hands your agent what you already figured out. It gives you one place for everything your agents have ever done. Move a full session between Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and any other agent with nothing lost, including the entire conversation, the model's reasoning, and every tool call, not just a summary, so the next agent picks up like it was there the whole time. Skillsync is local-first and yours, and its core engine, txcript, is open source, a portable session format that no single provider owns.

companies.name: RoboDock
companies.one_liner: Robots that run autonomous depots for autonomous fleets.
companies.long_description: RoboDock builds robots that automate depot operations, like charging and vehicle checks, for electric and autonomous vehicle fleets. We turn fleet depots from manual sites into self-running systems that lower operational costs and increase vehicle uptime.

companies.name: Scheduling Wizard
companies.one_liner: Logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations
companies.long_description:
Scheduling Wizard is building the logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations. Hospitals still rely on manual workflows to manage staffing, patient flow, and core operations, contributing to $760B in annual inefficiency.

20 departments across 16 hospitals already outsource their physician scheduling to us, powered by our internal Scheduling Programming Language and AI-driven workflows. We work with Mass General, Johns Hopkins, UT Southwestern, UCSF, and many others.

We are actively onboarding new clients and expanding into patient triaging and provider management systems, working with partner departments at UCSF and other leading institutions. Scheduling Wizard aims to bring healthcare operations into the future by reducing administrative burden and improving clinical care coordination. Our goal is to create the AI-native administrative layer in healthcare operations.

companies.name: Luel
companies.one_liner: Turning everyday words and actions into usable training data.
companies.long_description: Luel is a sourcing and licensing platform for rights-cleared multimodal training data at scale. We work with frontier AI teams to provide high-quality bespoke data collections and off-the-shelf datasets.

companies.name: Aemon
companies.one_liner: The Forward-Deployed AI Research Engineer
companies.long_description:
Aemon is the first autonomous research engineer that delivers state-of-the-art solutions to your engineering problems. It generates, tests, and evolves thousands of approaches at machine speed to discover optimal solutions beyond what human experts can find.

Aemon already set a new world record on an NP-hard math optimization problem with <$10 of compute, beating the previous record set by Google DeepMind in 2025.

Ray and Richard (twin brothers) dropped out of UWaterloo and UIUC to build Aemon. They published at top AI conferences like ICLR and EMNLP before turning 20.

companies.name: Ashr
companies.one_liner: Enterprise post-training, monitoring, and continual learning platform
companies.long_description:
Ashr Manifold is a self-contained model training, hosting, observability, and continual learning platform for purpose-built open-weight models. 

Startups can use Manifold to post-train and manage fleets of continuously improving open-weight models without having a dedicated research team or infrastructure. Ultimately, this reduces operating costs and allows a greater degree of control over proprietary company knowledge.

Enterprises can use Manifold to encode institutional judgements and priorities into open-weight models, reduce token costs, and manage every level of the AI life cycle, from data curation, to model serving on weights and infrastructure they own.

companies.name: CodeWisp
companies.one_liner: Anyone can create real games with AI
companies.long_description:
CodeWisp lets anyone build and publish web games using plain-English prompts.

Traditional game development requires learning complex engines, managing assets and code, and following rigid workflows, making it slow and inaccessible for most people.

With CodeWisp, users describe the game they want. CodeWisp generates the game’s code, structure, and assets, and users can refine it with follow-up prompts. This makes it possible to go from idea to a playable web game in minutes, without prior game-development experience.

CodeWisp also makes Petlings: Merge & Battle, a free pet merge game for iPhone and iPad: https://playpetlings.com/

companies.name: OctaPulse
companies.one_liner: OctaPulse builds computer vision and robotics for fish farms and…
companies.long_description:
OctaPulse is building the robotics layer for seafood production. Aquaculture is the fastest-growing food sector and already produces more seafood than commercial fishing, yet the people who breed and process fish still make thousands of decisions a day with almost no data about the fish in front of them, and much of the most important work is still done by hand, one fish at a time.

We put cameras where fish are already handled, turn every image into measurements, and give farms and plants the tools to act on them. Today that is two products: Phenotyping, which measures every fish for shape, size and condition and links it to its family for breeding decisions, and Digital Twin, which places cameras on processing lines and farm sites onto the floor plan with live views, automatic counts and a built-in AI assistant.

The same per-fish measurements are the foundation for Plant Robotics: robot cells that handle whole fish on the processing line, working alongside the people there. Fish are wet, slippery, soft and never the same twice, which is exactly why this work is still manual and why it needs measurement-driven robots built for food plants rather than rigid grippers and tabletop demos. We are now selecting processing plants for the first pilots on real lines.

We signed a 6-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in the United States, and every deployment adds labeled images to a proprietary multi-species dataset that improves our models across species and becomes the brain for autonomous seafood production.

companies.name: Beyond Reach Labs
companies.one_liner: Space solar arrays that grow to the size of a football field in orbit
companies.long_description:
At Beyond Reach Labs we are building solar panels for Space that grow from the size of a dining table to a football field in orbit.

Mitch and Pele met 13 years ago as freshmen at UPenn studying mechanical engineering. Mitch recently got his PhD at Carnegie Mellon working with NASA on kilometer-scale deployable structures, and Pele spent seven years at SpaceX leading Dragon parachute engineering, safely returning astronauts from space.

The collective satellites today use around 20MW, roughly the output of a datacenter on earth, but by 2030 there is a demand for over 10GW, a 500x increase, largely driven by orbital datacenters, space stations, and lunar outposts.

If you want more power, your only option is to launch larger solar panels, which quickly become fragile or impractically expensive. As a result, power constraints already determine whether missions or industries can exist at all.

But at Beyond Reach Labs we have introduced a new class of deployable solar panels giving satellites 10x more usable power without increasing launch mass or volume. This works because our patented deployable design changes geometry in space, allowing for us to reach 10x longer while remaining rigid.

companies.name: Milliray
companies.one_liner: Technology to detect and track small drones
companies.long_description:
We make radars that can see small drones.

As drones evolve faster than air defenses, detection has fallen behind. Even $50 drones now present a major threat to airports, critical infrastructure, and front-line defense.

We solve this by building high-frequency radar systems, designed from the ground up to detect even the most challenging low-signature targets. This allows us to identify and track nano drones like no other solution, letting you know what's truly in your airspace.

companies.name: RamAIn
companies.one_liner: RamAIn - AI Employees with a computer to perform business tasks just…
companies.long_description: RamAIn Employees join your team just like a human. Teach them to work across systems just like a new hire and watch them work autonomously to do the work 24/7.

companies.name: Moritz
companies.one_liner: Global AI-native law firm handling legal work with same-day turnaround
companies.long_description:
Moritz is a global AI-native law firm that will handles legal work with same day turnaround.

Our lawyers have closed $ 3bn in deals with an average turnaround of 4-hours. No other law firm offers this kind of speed for complex deals.

We're backed by YC, 20VC and the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, Instacart, Reddit, Superhuman, Producthunt, HuggingFace and 15 other unicorn founders.

companies.name: Salus
companies.one_liner: Guardrails to validate your agent's actions before they execute
companies.long_description:
Your agent processed a refund without looking up the order ID, costing you thousands. You only found out three hours later from a support ticket. Evals, output scoring, and observability can reduce the likelihood of mistakes like these occurring - but there's no solution that inspects and prevents an action as it’s about to execute. Salus does that.

We’ve built an API that wraps around your agent and checks its actions at run time, blocking incorrect ones and providing immediate feedback to guide retries.

companies.name: EigenPal
companies.one_liner: AI Document Workflows for Enterprises
companies.long_description: EigenPal.com automates your document processing workflows with AI. KYC docs, invoices, claims, shipping forms, contracts, receipts, loan docs - we automate that. Works on messy scans, handwritten forms, third-party docs. Powerful workflow builder and team functionality. On-prem ready or use our cloud.

companies.name: Sparkles
companies.one_liner: Make everyone on your team an engineer
companies.long_description:
Sparkles gives your whole team coding agents that work on your real codebase.

Connect your GitHub repos once, and anyone on the team can start a run from the web app or by @mentioning Sparkles in Slack. Pick Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode and describe the change in plain language. The agent works in an isolated cloud sandbox with your tools already plugged in, like Linear, Sentry, Notion and Figma. You can watch every command and file edit live and jump in mid-run.

Every run ends as a GitHub pull request. CI checks stream back into Sparkles, and your reviews and branch protections still apply, so prod stays safe.

companies.name: Fern
companies.one_liner: RL environments for robotics companies
companies.long_description: Fern build high fidelity simulations for robotics, specifically focused on manipulation tasks. Customers have run over 900k simulation rollouts for RL and evaluations, and have verified that the simulation fidelity is high enough such that the real to sim and sim to real gap is very small.

companies.name: Perfectly
companies.one_liner: The AI-native Recruiting OS
companies.long_description:
Perfectly is the first AI-native Recruiting OS.

Since starting YC, we’re already helping top startups like Giga, Corgi, LlamaIndex, Porter, and dozens more hire faster.

We’re seeing:
-> 4× faster hiring
-> 10× candidate volume
-> 2× higher interview pass rates

Behind the scenes, it’s even more impressive:
-> 20x higher recruiting efficiency: from 20 hours to 1 hour
-> 250% higher candidate interview retention

We automate the entire recruiting function: sourcing, outreach, screening, and qualification. Interview ready candidates just show up in Slack. 

We recently launched our recruiting agent Paul that provides each candidate white glove treatment so they're closed even before your offer call

Hiring should work like a recommendation system.

Learn more now at perfectly.so

companies.name: Orthogonal
companies.one_liner: Agentic Payments for APIs
companies.long_description: APIs weren't built for agents. Orthogonal fixes that. We enable agentic payments so any agent can instantly discover, access, and pay for hundreds of APIs. No subscriptions, no sales calls, just pay per use. API providers list once and get paid every time an agent calls their API.

companies.name: Q2Q
companies.one_liner: We help private equity teams find acquisition targets faster
companies.long_description:
Q2Q is the AI-native outbound engine for deal sourcing. Tell us the types of companies you want to buy, and we'll get qualified meetings booked for you. 

You can think of Q2Q as your personal team of AI interns. You give us your buying criteria, and we'll go out and find companies, write personalized emails, and get first calls booked with business owners for you. As the human in the loop, you'll approve messages before we send. Q2Q handles the sourcing work so you can focus on evaluating great deals.

companies.name: Ventura
companies.one_liner: AI Workforce for Distributors and Manufacturers
companies.long_description: Ventura builds the AI workforce for distributors and manufacturers, starting with quoting and order entry. It plugs into your existing ERP, follows your SOPs, and learns your team's tribal knowledge - getting smarter with every completed task.

companies.name: Terranox AI
companies.one_liner: The first AI-powered uranium discovery company
companies.long_description: Terranox is the first vertically integrated AI-powered uranium exploration company. We find high-grade uranium deposits in North America using AI trained on 70+ years of exploration outcomes. Our mission is to find the fuel we need to power the next century with nuclear energy.

companies.name: Sponge
companies.one_liner: Financial infrastructure for the agent economy
companies.long_description:
Sponge is the easiest way for agents to hold and spend money, and for businesses to sell directly to them.

For agents: Sponge lets agents hold funds and transact autonomously with other agents and businesses using bank accounts, cards, and crypto. Agents can autonomously purchase services such as email, browser use, and premium data without human involvement.

For businesses: Sponge makes it easy to onboard and accept payments from agents without human interaction. Businesses can sell their services directly to agents with a few clicks, no code changes required.

companies.name: Mango Medical
companies.one_liner: Foundation models for planning orthopedic surgery
companies.long_description: Mango Medical builds agentic surgical planning AI for orthopedic surgery. We deliver surgeon-ready plans in minutes instead of days. 8-figure LOI from a top orthopedic company. Pursuing FDA 510(k) clearance. We're building a future where every surgery follows a personalized plan.

companies.name: Confluence Labs
companies.one_liner: AI models that learn from experience
companies.long_description:
While modern AI excels in any area you can collect a lot of data for, it struggles in areas where data is sparse or costly to attain. Designing new molecules, discovering new physics, and engineering new materials are all domains where collecting data is extremely costly. 

We dream of a world where AI accelerates research in all of these domains and creates a more abundant future for humanity, but the current technology is not there. That’s why we started Confluence Labs. 

We are building AI that can design highly effective experiments in data-sparse domains and learn maximally from the data it already has.

companies.name: Opalite Health
companies.one_liner: Helping Healthcare Providers Speak Any Language
companies.long_description:
Opalite makes it easy for healthcare providers to communicate with non-English speaking patients. We’re built to work inside existing clinical workflows, so providers can communicate in real time without waiting for an interpreter or delaying care. 

Opalite is available instantly, 24/7, and replaces traditional interpretation services with software that’s more reliable and saves millions of dollars per year.

We've built a voice AI system that is the safest, most compliant, and most accurate medical interpreter in the world.

companies.name: Compresr
companies.one_liner: LLM context compression for better accuracy
companies.long_description: Compresr provides an API that compresses LLM context without losing what matters. It’s a drop-in for agents and RAG that cuts token costs and improves accuracy.

companies.name: IncidentFox
companies.one_liner: AI SRE agent that triages, coordinates, and fixes production incidents
companies.long_description: AI SRE agents that automatically learn each customer’s system so they work just like an in-house engineer.

companies.name: Unisson
companies.one_liner: AI agents that automate B2B software implementation
companies.long_description:
Unisson is building trusted AI subject-matter experts for teams that are responsible for customer deployments (technical customer success, implementation, sales engineering). Within 20 minutes, our agents learn to use any product and can be used by teams in Slack, text, or email. Our agents gather requirements and context from existing tools enabling them to handle complex tasks like customer health audits, onboarding, product administration, and custom integrations. 

With Unisson, customer-facing teams have 24/7 access to an AI SME, allowing them to scale and save thousands of hours.

companies.name: Stilta
companies.one_liner: Agentic AI for intellectual property
companies.long_description:
Stilta builds agentic AI software for intellectual property, starting with patent litigation. Whether challenging or enforcing a patent, leading IP law firms and in-house IP teams use Stilta for source-backed, auditable analysis.

Innovation drives the world's most important breakthroughs, but the tools that protect it haven't kept pace. Patent attorneys do high-stakes work with a process still built on manual document review and disconnected point solutions. Generative AI helps with drafting, but it doesn't deliver the trust and transparency that legal-grade work demands - no sources, no traceability, no audit trail. Stilta takes a different approach. We use agentic AI to run search and analysis at a scale manual methods can't match, with every output source-backed, referenced, and auditable. Until recently, this wasn't technically possible.

We're four engineers from McKinsey/QuantumBlack who built and deployed AI systems at some of the world's largest organizations. With Stilta, we're equipping the people who protect the world's most valuable ideas with tools that match the stakes.

companies.name: Instinct
companies.one_liner: Trade with superhuman instinct
companies.long_description:
Capital allocation is becoming a more important part of individual economic life.
Finance is moving toward a global, onchain, 24/7 future with thousands of markets trading at once.

The asset management industry is built around the scarcity of financial expertise and the cost of organizing people around capital. 

Institutions cover global markets by employing analysts, researchers, and quants around the clock. 

AI turns this organizational capacity into software.

Instinct is building the harness for this transition.

Instinct is a proactive team of agents that searches thousands of markets, investigates opportunities, and operates 24/7. The individual becomes the portfolio manager, Instinct becomes the investment firm operating around them.

As institutional advantages become widely accessible, the edge concentrates in each trader’s worldview, judgment, and bets. 

The first one-person investment firm managing $1 billion will emerge within two years.

It will run on Instinct.

companies.name: Proximitty
companies.one_liner: AI operating system for commercial loans
companies.long_description:
Proximitty is the AI operating system for commercial loans - we build regulator-grade AI agents that ingest and parse documents, spread financials, automate loan operations and track covenants.

We help FDIC-insured banks and fintechs underwrite faster and scale their loan books without scaling costs.

companies.name: Cajal
companies.one_liner: Scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery
companies.long_description:
Cajal (YC W26) is massively scaling formal verification to accelerate scientific discovery. We deploy superhuman AI mathematicians to high-impact applied domains, starting with quantum computing and finance.

We do this with Lean - a framework that allows us to formally verify any mathematical statement, grounding AI in truth and validating the tools discovered by our systems.

companies.name: Overshoot
companies.one_liner: We optimize inference stacks for teams
companies.long_description:
Overshoot makes AI models run faster and cheaper on your hardware.

Serving engines like vLLM and SGLang were designed for the average workload. This results in most deployments being extremely inefficient, especially around throughput (hence cost). 

We profile your workload on your hardware, then build a custom deployment image tuned to the metrics you care about, within the quality limits you set.

You only pay if we meet the performance target we agree on.

companies.name: Terminal Use
companies.one_liner: AI-native transformation for operations-heavy companies
companies.long_description:
AI pilots are everywhere. Few organizations can point to a department that actually runs AI-first. Terminal Use changes that.

We help operations teams rebuild how work gets done, end to end. We begin with one critical process, map how it runs today and where it breaks, then redesign the workflow around AI agents, existing systems, and people at the right control points.
The result is a working AI-first process, measurable operational change, and a blueprint for transforming the broader department.

Founded by ex-Palantir FDEs and engineers working on transformation at scale, Terminal Use works across construction, logistics, manufacturing, retail, and other complex operating environments.

companies.name: Laurence
companies.one_liner: Quantitative research for autonomous e-commerce growth
companies.long_description:
Advertising today is like trading in the 1980s pits: archaic, manual, and iterative guesswork. Humans update bids and keywords with noisy, delayed data using simple if-else rules that both break at scale and ignore stochasticity.

Laurence advertises like modern hedge funds trade markets, driving a 15-40% improvement in net profit for Amazon brands within a month of onboarding.

companies.name: Parameter
companies.one_liner: AI pentesting, that works!
companies.long_description:
Parameter builds AI agents that run continuous penetration tests against your apps and infrastructure. Instead of a once-a-year penetration test, Parameter's agents works 24/7 to find and verify critical vulnerabilities so you can prevent them before attackers.

Formerly Hex Security

companies.name: Pax Historia
companies.one_liner: The first AI-powered worldbuilding and gameplay platform
companies.long_description:
Pax Historia is an AI powered sandbox game where players create and upload whatever worlds they can imagine for others to play. What if Rome never fell? What if aliens invaded Earth? What if you were a college dropout creating a tech startup? 

The ability to create, edit, and copy custom maps, actors, historical context, and more means that users can play nearly any scenario they can imagine.

We've organically built a passionate fanbase of tens of thousands of daily active players and we're excited to expand on this early start. Consider joining us to help build vastly better tools for creators and experiences for players.

companies.name: Rhizome AI
companies.one_liner: Agent Platform for Life Sciences
companies.long_description:
It takes 500,000 days of office work to bring a drug to market. We want to make it 5. To get there, we need agents doing most of the work. 

Today, our research agent is the best way to know what the FDA thinks. Users ask a question and get an answer backed by up to 1,000 documents, where each statement has a citation. 

It’s the best because we have the best retrieval engine. We’ve tuned it on our life science-specific dataset, and we find what others miss.

As more teams use Rhizome, we gain more data on what regulatory professionals actually need, which makes retrieval even better. This flywheel is how we become the retrieval engine that powers all human and agent work in life sciences.

Chetan started his career as a research engineer, but quickly realized he enjoyed building more than research. He joined EvolutionaryScale as their sole founding product engineer, launching their developer-scientist platform and scaling to tens of thousands of users and billions of API calls. He was also #16 at Instabase helping banks with document processing, closing $7m as the technical closer.

Agents can do magical things today, but most in life sciences only use them to edit emails. Agents are missing the context they need to 100x the number of drugs we can bring to market. Rhizome AI is focused on that critical problem.
companies.all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote

companies.name: Prana
companies.one_liner: An AI primary care doctor in your pocket
companies.long_description:
Prana replaces the reactive, 15-minute annual physical with continuous, proactive care. We connect to your medical records and wearables to watch for "clinical drift," catching subtle declines in health that human doctors miss between visits.

Most AI health apps are just chatbots. Prana is a full-stack medical provider. Our AI acts as a always-on physician that watches your data, explains your labs, and manages your prescriptions.

Safety & Scale: We automate 90% of the "grunt work" (history taking, logistics, triage) so our human doctors can focus purely on high-leverage decisions. This allows us to offer 24/7 physician care for a fraction of the cost of traditional care.

The Team:
 - Meer Patel (CEO): JHU BME. Deferred Brown Medical School to build Prana because code scales better than appointments.
- Vishvam Rawal (CTO): Ex-Quant. Building high-frequency data infrastructure for health signals.
- Sanjit Menon (CHO): Graduating MD Candidate. Deep clinical expertise to ensure our models practice good medicine.

Traction: Live in beta with early users.

companies.name: Cardboard
companies.one_liner: AI video editor (raw footage into finished videos)
companies.long_description:
Cardboard (cardboard.ai) is an AI video editor that turns raw footage into finished videos, from social clips and highlight reels to product demos, launch videos and event recaps. Describe the video you want, and Cardboard turns your clips, photos, recordings or a link into an edit you can watch, change and export, in the browser, in the Mac app, or right inside ChatGPT and Claude. It pulls out the best moments, removes pauses and filler words, adds captions, titles, music and B-roll, and reframes for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. It’s built for marketing teams, founders and creators who need video every week without learning a timeline.

Say what you need, like “three 30-second ad variants” or “a customer testimonial from these interviews”, and Cardboard’s AI agent, Director, builds a first cut in minutes. You refine it by chatting or on a full timeline, with your team. Cardboard edits the footage you already have. Unlike AI video generators such as Runway or Sora, it doesn’t create new video from a text prompt.

- Recreate the style of a reference video with your own footage.
- Make motion graphics from a prompt, from animated titles to 3D scenes like a spinning product shot.
- Cut to the beat, with match cuts, transitions and effects synced to the music.
- 80+ ready-made recipes (templates) for videos like launch videos, product showcases, podcast clips, webinar highlights, and testimonials.
- Export the finished video, or hand the timeline off to Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

Why now: AI models can finally understand video, and WebGPU makes a professional editor possible in a browser tab. Most AI video tools are either an old editor with AI bolted on, or an agent with no real editor behind it. Cardboard is built to be both.

Team: Saksham Aggarwal (CEO) and Ishan Sharma (CTO) have been friends for 15 years, since school. Saksham studied computer science at BITS Pilani, was co-founder and CTO of Iterate AI (backed by Entrepreneur First), and worked in growth at Sequoia-backed Flint. Ishan spent nearly five years building performance-critical browser apps at HackerRank (YC S11), and at 14 built Hotspoter, a Windows app with over 5 million downloads.

Together, they are unusually suited to build the editor core others avoid.
