Video is becoming the default distribution channel, and the team that iterates fastest compounds attention. Cardboard becomes the default workspace for video production, the way Canva/Figma became the workspace for design - because it’s collaborative, fast, and does the tedious parts for you.

(formerly usecardboard.com or cardboard.sh)

companies.name: Jinba
companies.one_liner: Automate enterprise workflows through chat
companies.long_description:
Jinba lets enterprise teams vibe-code AI workflows instead of drag and drop. Describe what you need in plain language, and your whole company can start using it immediately. No engineers required. Enterprise-grade permissions, audit logging, and on-prem deployment built in. We serve 40,000 enterprise users at major financial institutions.

Build something your colleagues want.

companies.name: Seeing Systems
companies.one_liner: Modular AI-Commanded Drones for Defence
companies.long_description:
We engineer inexpensive, autonomous strike drones designed to operate in the most contested combat environments on Earth!

By combining true hardware modularity with an agentic control system that lowers cognitive load on operators, we enable faster upgrades, broader adoption, and more than 2x reduction in lifecycle cost.

Our customers and partners include the UK Royal Marine Commandos, several other units in the UK, and 4 other NATO forces, and we are currently shipping prototypes for iterative feedback.

Think of us as Anduril, but with worse weather, and better banter.

companies.name: Synthetic Sciences
companies.one_liner: Infrastructure for Autonomous Science
companies.long_description: Synthetic Sciences is a research lab building infrastructure for scientific superintelligence. Empirical science is bottlenecked by verification that is slow, expensive, and imperfect. We work on tooling, evals, training environments, algorithms, and labs that make autonomous science possible.

companies.name: Visibl Semiconductors
companies.one_liner: Custom silicon for power electronics
companies.long_description:
Visibl Semiconductors makes custom silicon accessible to hardware companies, starting with power electronics. We are an AI-native custom-silicon design partner that cuts ASIC development cost and timeline on mature nodes, helping teams deliver better performance and lower BOM cost.

We work with data-center and AI-infrastructure power, motor drives, industrial automation and robotics, industrial power supplies and conversion, battery systems and e-mobility powertrains, EV charging, solar, energy storage, grid power, HVAC, heat pumps, and appliances.

V1 boards built from off-the-shelf parts are great for getting to market quickly, but scaling to v2+ volume requires optimizing cost, size, and manufacturability. Visibl folds those parts into custom silicon built around the product: a simpler BOM, reclaimed board space, fewer supply constraints, and automation-ready assembly.

We manage the full path from architecture and design through verification, fabrication, packaging, and production-ready silicon, working alongside hardware teams so they do not need an in-house chip team.

companies.name: Patientdesk.ai
companies.one_liner: AI front & back office agent for dental practices
companies.long_description: Patientdesk is an AI bookings system that helps healthcare practices make more money. We do this by handling bookings, payments, and insurance to fill up a provider's calendar with high value appointments.

companies.name: Chamber
companies.one_liner: The AIOps Agent for ML Teams
companies.long_description: Chamber puts your AI infrastructure on autopilot, and saves your machine learning engineers hours of manual effort. Our agents continually monitor, detects failures, provide root-cause analysis, resolve issues, and optimize AI workloads and scale across clouds. It operates like an autonomous infrastructure team, helping save your research and engineers hours each day, and debugging workload performance issues. Your ML teams move faster, infra waste drops, and GPU bottlenecks disappear.

companies.name: End Close
companies.one_liner: AI powered reconciliation for high-volume payments companies
companies.long_description:
End Close builds automatic reconciliation for payments companies like fintechs, marketplaces, banks and payroll companies. Reconciliation helps companies track every dollar and resolve every exception, ensuring they have no money loss, can report audit ready financials, and stay compliant.

Sean (CEO) spent the last 6 years building the reconciliation org at Modern Treasury (S18), processing a trillion dollars in payments across 40 banks with 99.995% automation. Fast growing companies like Modern Treasury are forced to build a solution in-house or buy a legacy solution. End Close provides a modern reconciliation system that works with a company's existing stack and is managed by AI agents.

Exception handling is where 99% of the manual work happens today, payment ops teams spend hours gathering context across various data sources to investigate each ticket. End Close provides an AI ops agent that connects to a company's data warehouse, invoicing platform and payment processors to triage and resolve issues without human intervention.

Legacy providers only provide reconciliation for month end close applications. End Close continuously reconciles with developer friendly APIs, allowing teams to integrate real time payments data within their products to create product experiences for customers like faster balance top-ups, instant trading etc. 

New payment rails and agent-to-agent payments are increasing online transaction volumes, making reconciliation a growing challenge for companies. David (CTO and 2nd time YC founder) most recently built these kinds of high-scale ingestion pipelines when starting and leading error tracking at PostHog (W20), the fastest growing product in the company's history.

companies.name: Fenrock AI
companies.one_liner: AI agents for banks
companies.long_description: We're building the Legora for traditional financial services, working closely with US bank CEOs to transform their businesses.

companies.name: Maywood
companies.one_liner: The first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7
companies.long_description:
Maywood is the first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7, working across your network, pipeline, and active processes, running constantly in the background and surfacing things you'd otherwise miss. It tracks relationships and sector context to flag when a target is gearing up for a process (and drafts the outreach in your voice), watches network activity across LinkedIn, news, and conference follow-ups, and surfaces where active processes stand, including what's at risk since you last looked.

It also auto-updates CRMs and trackers and creates meeting briefs that includes relationship history, recent activity, deal context, external research, talking points that can pull from internal and external data sources. Dealmakers interact with it over email, Teams, or the platform itself.

companies.name: Revion
companies.one_liner: Intelligence for Automotive Operations
companies.long_description: Revion is building the operating system for Automotive Retail. Our first product helps Technicians automate administrative work, which drains 30-40% of their day. With Revion, Auto Retailers can service more vehicles and drive more high-margin Revenue.

companies.one_liner: Custom models and inference, built and run for enterprises

companies.name: SideKit
companies.one_liner: Consumer app studio.
companies.long_description: SideKit is a consumer app studio that makes Island, a different kind of screen time app.

companies.name: Valence
companies.one_liner: Unified prediction markets trading platform
companies.long_description: Valence is a unified trading platform for prediction markets. We provide infrastructure to aggregate and execute contracts across Kalshi, Polymarket, and other platforms, surface arbitrage and mispricing opportunities in real time, and give systematic traders the API and backtesting tools they need to build and execute data-driven strategies on anything.

companies.name: Reframe
companies.one_liner: AI-native, hardware procurement marketplace
companies.long_description: Reframe is the only AI-native marketplace for hardware teams to procure both COTS and custom manufactured components. We have access to trusted suppliers that have made parts for the most reliable hardware products that people use today (iPhones, Teslas, and more). We use Agents to automate end-to-end procurement so that hardware teams can scale while remaining lean.

companies.name: Congruent
companies.one_liner: AI native radars for self-driving cars
companies.long_description: At Congruent, we build radars for end-to-end autonomous systems. The most advanced autonomous systems are trained as a single neural network from raw sensor data to navigation actions. For a sensor to be included in these pipelines sensor stacks requires two key properties: access to raw sensor data and a high-fidelity sensor simulator. Current automotive radars have neither, they output heavily processed point clouds and no raw radar simulator exists for driving scenes. Congruent solves both problems: a radar architecture that exposes raw data, paired with a world model based radar simulator. Radar is the only depth sensor at a price point that scales to every car on the road and works in all weather conditions. Congruent is building the radar compatible with the training architectures that will make mass-market vehicles autonomous.

companies.name: InventoryQuant
companies.one_liner: We automate the inventory process in insurance
companies.long_description: We automate inventory and contents processing for insurance and insurance-adjacent industries, including public adjusters, restoration contents, and insurance companies. We also handle various inventory and estimate adjacent processes that cost many billions of dollars a year and thousands of years of man hours.

companies.name: Emdash
companies.one_liner: One app for all your coding agents
companies.long_description:
Emdash brings Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents into one app.

Run agents in parallel on your own infrastructure, Emdash Cloud or locally. Start tasks from Slack, Linear or GitHub, and let agents keep working after you close your laptop. Access sessions from web, desktop or mobile.

Share environments, skills, MCP servers and secrets across your team, with centralized access and spend controls. Bring your existing AI subscriptions and cloud commitments. No lock-in.

companies.name: Ressl AI
companies.one_liner: Train, eval and build autonomous agents
companies.long_description: Ressl AI helps teams bridge the gap from prototype to production by providing the platform needed to train, benchmark, and deploy autonomous agents that actually work in real-world business systems.

companies.name: Robby
companies.one_liner: AI agents that grow revenue for home services businesses
companies.long_description:
Robby is an AI growth engine for home services businesses that uncovers revenue opportunities and collects additional data from every technician visit. Our AI combines customer and third party data to generate dozens of new leads every day, and then arms the technicians with talking points to increase close rates, giving GMs a single command center to manage and drive revenue. We have several paying customers that are each uncovering 6 figures in additional revenue opportunities every week. On our first day of launch, we helped close $40k in new business within an hour.

Our team has spent the last few months riding along with dozens of technicians and shadowing every position in the office to best understand the industry. We're also studying for the EPA 608 exam to become certified technicians ourselves.

Vineet and Feroze have both built critical products and infra at prominent startups (Ironclad, Porter, Affinity, Uber, Cloud Health Systems). Joe previously consulted PE firms on software acquisitions and led home services growth projects at Bain. We all met at Harvard Business School, and dropped out to work on Robby full-time.

companies.name: Sitefire
companies.one_liner: Marketing suite for the agentic web
companies.long_description: Sitefire (YC W26) helps brands market their products to agents. They create content and tools that get their products discovered and used by AI agents (ChatGPT, OpenClaw). Sitefire identifies which content drives AI visibility, and automatically creates it. The teams using Sitefire execute on-page and off-page actions to deliver measurable top-line growth.

companies.name: Forum
companies.one_liner: The first exchange to trade on attention.
companies.long_description:
Forum is building the first exchange to trade on cultural attention.

We create indices from search, social, and streaming data to measure what the world cares about, enabling users to go long or short on changes in relevance.

Attention is the primary driver of business success in the digital age, but it has never been directly tradable. Forum introduces attention as a new asset class for managing cultural and demand risk.

companies.name: Human Archive
companies.one_liner: Physical AI data lab
companies.long_description:
Human Archive (YC W26) is building the data and deployments infrastructure for physical AI.

We design hardware, deploy cameras and sensors globally, and train models that help AI better understand how humans interact with the physical world.

Leading frontier AI labs trust us for their video, sensor, robot deployment, image, and audio datasets.

We have offices in SF, China, and India and are researchers from NYU GRAIL, UPenn GRASP, UC Berkeley, Stanford, Johns Hopkins Robotics, and national robotics champions.

To get data, please reach out to raj@humanarchive.ai

companies.name: Samora AI
companies.one_liner: Multilingual voice agents that outperform humans
companies.long_description:
Samora runs multilingual voice operations for organizations with high-volume calling without requiring engineering teams, call centers, or AI expertise.

Many important tasks still depend on phone calls, including customer support, outreach, follow-ups, screening, and intake. But voice AI often fails in production because real callers interrupt, go off-script, switch languages mid-sentence, and speak in local dialects. Teams also worry about safety and compliance, especially when an agent can accidentally make the wrong promise.

Samora solves this with voice agents that sound local and follow strict rules. Samora agents handle inbound and outbound calls, collect information, and update internal systems like CRMs, ticketing tools, and ATS platforms. When a call becomes sensitive or uncertain, the agent hands off to a human. It can also follow up over WhatsApp, SMS, or email when needed.

With Samora, teams get:
1. Voice agents that work in real conversations, including dialects and code-switching
2. Strict safety controls so agents don’t make unauthorized offers, discounts, or promises
3. Calls that result in completed actions, system updates, and safe human handoff

companies.name: Caretta
companies.one_liner: Realtime AI for Sales Calls
companies.long_description:
Caretta is a Sales Intelligence for revenue teams. It joins reps in live calls, helping them handle information requests, questions, and objections in real time. Caretta lives in Slack to join the team conversation.

Caretta gets smarter automatically: every call expands its knowledge base and objection library, turning conversations into compounding organizational advantage.

companies.name: Oximy
companies.one_liner: Take command of the AI your company already runs on.
companies.long_description: Oximy is one platform to see every AI tool and dollar across your company, run your team’s work in an app you own, and route every request to the right model.

companies.name: AxionOrbital Space
companies.one_liner: Foundation models for 24/7 Earth Observation
companies.long_description:
AxionOrbital Space builds foundation models that enable continuous visibility through clouds and darkness. Legacy optical satellites are rendered useless 70% of the time by weather and night cycles, while Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) produces data that is unintelligible to humans and breaks standard vision pipelines.

We solve this by translating raw radar backscatter into analysis-ready optical imagery in real-time. Our proprietary architecture uses deterministic one-step diffusion to transform complex radar signals into clear, photorealistic images. This enables persistent, 24/7 situational awareness for defense, commodities trading, and disaster response, guaranteeing visibility even when the sky is blocked.

companies.name: Mendral
companies.one_liner: AI DevOps Engineer
companies.long_description: Mendral is an AI DevOps Engineer that observes, diagnoses, acts, and learns continuously. It autonomously handles CI failures, flaky tests, slow builds, broken releases, and code reviews, improving with every build and run. Over time, Mendral evolves into a self-improving delivery system that manages performance, quality, security, and compliance, all without manual intervention.

companies.name: Constellation Space
companies.one_liner: AI operating system for mega-scale satellite networks.
companies.long_description:
Constellation Space is building the autonomous infrastructure layer for the next generation of space networking. As satellite constellations rapidly scale from hundreds of nodes to tens of thousands, traditional ground-based orchestration fundamentally breaks down. ConstellationOS bridges this gap by providing zero-intervention network handoffs, predictive thermal load-balancing, and sub-second optical routing.

Our founding team spent years building and operating satellite systems at SpaceX, Blue Origin, and NASA. We started Constellation to solve the problem we kept running into: reactive monitoring doesn't scale.

We are building the sub-second routing protocols and hyperscale load-balancing infrastructure that will manage the future of off-world telecommunications and compute. 

hello@constellation-io.com

companies.name: Byteport
companies.one_liner: Global upload acceleration for 1GB-100TB files.
companies.long_description: Founded in 2025, Byteport is a technology company that builds mission-critical network infrastructure for robotics, satellite, AI, and enterprise applications all over the world. Businesses of every size—from new startups to public companies—use our software to accelerate file transfer online.

companies.name: Pocket
companies.one_liner: Take Notes in the Real World
companies.long_description: Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and now European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.

companies.name: Bubble Lab
companies.one_liner: The intelligence layer for communities and events.
companies.long_description: Bubble Lab is the all-in-one platform for running professional communities and events. From member data and operations to automations and billing, everything in one place. Try it now or book a demo!

companies.name: Polymath

companies.name: Voxel Energy

companies.long_description:
The best grid connection is no grid connection. Voxel builds vertically integrated energy generation and storage systems for data centers that bypass utility connection delays. 

By leveraging the vast supply of second-life EV batteries and our novel DC microgrid architecture, Voxel generates datacenter power on site and drastically reduces system cost and time-to-power.

companies.name: Servo7

companies.long_description:
We deploy robots in warehouses to automate the most demanding job in logistics: unloading loose-loaded containers.

Our customers include 3PLs (CEVA, Stord), distributors (DHL, PostNL) and many more logistics companies.

companies.name: Ditto Biosciences
companies.one_liner: Evolutionary intelligence for autoimmune disease
companies.long_description:
Ditto Bio discovers drugs for autoimmune diseases by harnessing parasite biology. Viruses, ticks, and worms have experimented over millions of years to create proteins that control the human immune system. We use AI to identify these proteins and engineer them into next-generation autoimmune therapies.

Our team is three PhD scientists from UCSF, UCSD, and UC Berkeley who have worked together for 3+ years in biotech. We have deep expertise in parasite biology, computational biology, and software for AI-based protein structure prediction

companies.name: Sequence Markets
companies.one_liner: Low-latency execution across crypto, prediction, and tokenized assets
companies.long_description:
Sequence Markets lets traders execute across crypto exchanges, prediction markets, and tokenized-asset venues from one system.

We built proprietary low-latency infrastructure and routing software so users can package one market view into one trade with the speed, access, and transparency execution requires.

companies.name: Doomersion
companies.one_liner: Doomscroll to learn languages
companies.long_description:
Doomersion (formerly Doomlingo) lets you learn languages by doomsrolling! Watch TikToks in your target language that are exactly matched to your level, and as you scroll, they get a little bit harder.

Gen-Z doomscrolls 2.5-3 hours a day, and if we bake immersion into that by only showing them viral videos in another language that are matched to their level, we can make the optimal language learning method addictive for people. Hence the name, doomersion.

The app gained ~15k downloads in the first two weeks, and power users spend ~3+ hours daily on the app. Feel free to download and try it yourself!

companies.name: o11
companies.one_liner: OpenRouter wallet for paid goods and services
companies.long_description:
o11 helps your AI agents access apis, tools, and other paid goods and services. Instead of hacky computer use, managing credit card permissions, assigning each agent a new email, we handle all the hard parts of accessing the paid web. o11 has zero markup and gives teams better prices, easy checkout, and full auditability when purchasing with AI agents. 

The o11 wallet gives your AI agents access to the paid world.

companies.name: Anchorhead
companies.one_liner: Evals for frontier research agents
companies.long_description:
We build custom evals for product teams, as a service. To build these eval sets, we source domain experts and have them turn their work into original, real world evals.

For example, our research engineering experts have create tasks involving optimizing an algorithm, deploying a model, or running experiments to solve a novel problem. A grader scores the agent’s performance, and these scores serve as signals during evaluations.

companies.name: Remy AI
companies.one_liner: Automating dexterous tasks in warehouses with AI-powered robots
companies.long_description: Building robots and training models for automating manipulation in warehouse, starting with e-commerce 3PLs

companies.name: Chasi
companies.one_liner: AI Revenue Engine for the Equipment Industry
companies.long_description:
Chasi deploys AI agents that help equipment dealers sell more, respond faster, and maximize fleet utilization - 24/7.

One-third of the cost to build and maintain the physical world goes to equipment, yet fleet utilization across the industry often sits below 60%. Billions in assets sit idle while dealers drown in phone calls, emails, and manual data entry. Missed quotes, slow follow-ups, and disconnected systems mean lost revenue every day.

Chasi plugs into a dealer's existing stack to deploy AI agents that handle sales, rentals, and service requests around the clock. The result: faster response times, higher utilization, and stronger margins, without adding headcount. We automate the busywork so teams can focus on what actually grows the business: customer relationships.

Akash Pavan and Sarman Aulakh have built tractors, race cars, and robots, and previously led AI deployments at Tesla, Boeing, and Cummins, where they saw firsthand how much operational value gets left on the table in equipment-heavy industries. Chasi is live across equipment businesses in the US and Europe.

companies.name: Balance
companies.one_liner: Full-Stack AI Accounting
companies.long_description: Balance is an AI accounting firm that helps SMBs close their monthly books. Our agents do the work of an in-house finance hire, reconciling books in real time and flagging issues before they become problems.

companies.name: Fort
companies.one_liner: Strength Tracking Wearable
companies.long_description: Fort is a wearable that tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Other wearables make you manually log every rep, set, and exercise, then provide unhelpful feedback or underestimate strength-related fatigue. We use heart rate and motion data to track your strength workouts for you, then provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps you achieve your goals.

companies.name: General Legal
companies.one_liner: Elite AI law firm for high growth companies
companies.long_description: We're the elite AI law firm for high growth companies. Our firm provides exceptional, top-of-market legal work across commercial, corporate and employment law, at speeds and prices that put traditional law firms to shame.

companies.name: Corelayer
companies.one_liner: AI production engineer for regulated industries
companies.long_description:
Corelayer is the AI-native platform for production software support, built for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. It continuously monitors alerts, logs, infrastructure, and underlying data for issues and uses agents to debug and suggest fixes.

We're helping SRE, production services, and on-call engineers at companies ranging from growth-stage fintechs to Fortune 500 financial institutions spend less time on support and more on high-leverage work.

companies.name: Booko
companies.one_liner: Dynamically pricing the whole economy.
companies.long_description: Booko helps businesses that sell bookable time slots make more money by dynamically pricing their time. Unlike physical inventory, unsold time slots disappear forever, yet most time-slot-based businesses still rely on static pricing. We integrate with existing booking systems to adjust prices and incentives based on historical utilization, availability, and demand. Early customers see ~20% revenue uplift by selling time that would have otherwise gone unsold.

companies.name: Foreman
companies.one_liner: Keeping contractors on the job site, not behind a desk.
companies.long_description:
Foreman is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built for construction contractors and the trade industry.
Today, contractors run complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never designed for construction — estimates in spreadsheets, plans in email, proposals copy-pasted from old Word docs, photos scattered across phones. Nothing talks to anything else, and the admin work never stops.
Foreman replaces that patchwork with a single platform that manages the full lifecycle of a construction job, from first estimate to final invoice. Contractors upload plans, photos, or a project description, and Foreman's AI instantly generates structured takeoffs, scoped estimates, and professional proposals — in minutes, not hours. From there, every customer record, document, permit, photo, change order, and conversation lives in one place, organized around the job.
The result: contractors spend less time buried in admin and more time building. They bid faster, manage jobs with less chaos, and close projects cleanly — without duct-taping five tools together to do it.

companies.name: Turnstone
companies.one_liner: The best model-agnostic Grokbot alternative
companies.long_description:
Turnstone is the best model-agnostic Grokbot alternative. Run persistent Agents on your Mac with the AI subscriptions or API keys you already have

On Turnstone, you can connect multiple AI subscriptions / API keys in one place, and build a team of agents just like you would on Grokbot. 

When a subscription runs out, your Agent can automatically move to another connected subscription with available capacity. You can switch between accounts and model providers within an agent, and its conversation and context persists.

companies.name: Squid
companies.one_liner: AI agents for power grid planning  🦑
companies.long_description:
We believe the electricity grid is the most important machine on Earth. If we want electrification to move fast, the teams planning and operating networks need software that is as modern as the challenge.

Our thesis is simple. Better decisions come from one unified, trusted network model. When everyone works from the same model, planning becomes consistent, assumptions are visible, and progress stops getting lost in spreadsheets and static reports.

Squid is AI powered grid planning in your browser. We have spent years inside National Grid, Octopus Energy, and AWS, building and learning what breaks. Now we are building what we wished existed.

companies.name: Fed10
companies.one_liner: AI Agents for Government Affairs
companies.long_description:
Fed10 is a legislative consulting firm staffed by AI agents. 

We monitor every bill across the U.S., flag threats to your business, and deliver actionable insights — the same work a $500/hr policy consultant does, but in seconds instead of days.

Built by three ex-lobbyists who passed legislation together.

companies.name: BeeSafe AI
companies.one_liner: Frontier AI Defenses for Social Engineering Attacks
companies.long_description:
BeeSafe AI is building the frontier model layer for social engineering defense. Cyberattacks have moved from code to conversation: attackers now use AI to carry out long-term, trust-based manipulation across SMS, voice, email, and social platforms, often inside encrypted channels where defenders cannot see, detect, or stop them.

BeeSafe changes that by deploying undercover AI agents that engage attackers directly, expose hidden infrastructure, and convert live adversarial conversations into actionable intelligence. Each engagement adds to BeeSafe's proprietary dataset of real attacker behavior and trains foundational models that continually learn about counter-persuasion, deception, and manipulation in the wild.

BeeSafe is starting in financial crime, where banks already value our data against Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud and money laundering, but the opportunity is far broader. The same data and models that uncover mule networks today can protect consumers, secure enterprises, and strengthen governments against the next generation of AI-powered social engineering attacks tomorrow.

companies.name: The Token Company
companies.one_liner: Compression middleware that improves LLM outputs
companies.long_description:
Compression middleware that removes context bloat in milliseconds, lowering costs and improving end-to-end latency.

Compression is especially effective across natural language workloads. In a blind LLM arena case study with one of our customers, compressed requests increased user preference, lowered costs, and lifted purchase volume by 5%.

companies.name: Moda
companies.one_liner: Your agents should never make the same mistake twice.
companies.long_description: Your agents should never make the same mistake twice. Moda helps you engineer better agents from production data. Find recurring failures, understand what caused them, and build evals from real agent runs. Compare models on the tasks your users actually need. Test changes to your prompts, tools, and workflows against past production traffic before you ship. Know what broke, what to change, and whether the fix worked.

companies.name: MochaCare

companies.long_description: MochaCare is an agentic management service for care organizations. We handle hiring, scheduling, and client intake end-to-end so our partners can focus on growth.

companies.name: VOYGR
companies.one_liner: The real-world intelligence and action layer
companies.long_description:
VOYGR is a better maps API every agent and AI app will need. Google says '4.2 stars, open till 10 – VOYGR knows the chef left, wait times doubled, and locals moved on. Our intelligent local search combines accurate place data with fresh web context – news, articles, and events. We expand beyond 10-15 map attributes into infinite, queryable place profiles, enabling agents to reason and act in the real world.

Maps are no longer browsed – LLMs/agents use them to reason and act. 20M+ apps/websites, up to 40% of search queries, and 20% of LLM prompts need local context. 
10-15 attributes per place are not enough for AI. Places change constantly - restaurants close, hours change, businesses move. LLMs struggle with semantic queries “Specialty coffee shops in SF with Wi-Fi, popular with YC founders”. Agents cannot reliably “parse half the internet” - they need real-world ontology

We’re experienced builders in maps, search, and ML to solve this. Vlad knows this space inside and out – he worked on the Google Maps APIs GTM, plus firsthand customer experience from building in ridesharing and travel. Yarik has spent over a decade leading ML/search teams at Apple, Google, and Meta. 

Google Places alone is a $XXB/Yr monopoly. Agents turn it into a transactional layer opportunity for local commerce and ads.

companies.name: SpotPay

companies.name: TensorTest
companies.one_liner: Evals, RL environments and training data for creative tasks
companies.long_description:
TensorTest (formerly Ritivel) builds evaluations, reinforcement-learning environments, and expert training data for AI labs developing creative agents, starting with video editing.

An agent can produce a valid video file without delivering an edit that meets the client’s brief. Labs need reliable ways to measure creative quality, identify failures, and give agents feedback they can learn from.

Our first benchmark, TimelineBench, gives agents client video-editing jobs with raw footage, audio, and a brief. It evaluates the finished work using a verifier calibrated on thousands of blind judgments from professional editors. Across 16 agents we tested, the best passed only 26.8% of jobs. Most failures came down to creative craft rather than broken output.

We offer labs private evaluations to identify where their models fail, training environments that use our verifier’s scores as rewards, and expert-created training data, including professional editing demonstrations, preference pairs, and grading rubrics. These offerings connect evaluation to training: identify what an agent gets wrong, provide feedback on its attempts, and supply examples of better work.

Our team comes from IIT Bombay and has trained language models and built agentic systems at Microsoft Research.

We work with some of the largest cattle ranches in the world. While the drones are herding, they're also estimating animal weights, measuring grass biomass, monitoring water levels, and flagging sick animals. We're building physical AI that lets a grazier manage thousands of head across millions of acres from their phone.

companies.name: DAIVIN!

companies.long_description: DAIVIN! builds tankless dive gear that unlocks breath autonomy in extreme environments. Starting from underwater environment our mission is to remove the need for dangerous, heavy and bulky oxygen tanks in space, air and on land and replace them with water!

companies.name: Fixture

companies.long_description: Fixture is a CRM for startups that helps you find your next customers and keep deals moving. Fixture agents suggest prospects similar to customers you’ve won and helps you follow up on active deals. Use it in your browser or from agents like ChatGPT and Claude.

companies.name: Aurorin CAD
companies.one_liner: Claude code for Mechanical Engineers
companies.long_description:
There are 2 problems:

The first, CAD software is slow and the second, designing with it is a tedious process with many steps. Aurorin solves both of these problems by being a CAD software built from the ground up on a modern tech stack with AI at its heart.

Building the CAD kernel lets us fully leverage AI while modernizing execution speed. Almost all existing CAD software (Solidworks, NX, Creo, Catia, Fusion 360, Onshape etc) use the same couple of underlying CAD kernels built in the 80's. It's common for these programs to take 4 hours to open a file.

Aurorin uses a custom parametric and B-Rep driven CAD Kernel built to take full advantage of modern CPUs and GPUs and be AI native.

companies.name: Carrot Labs
companies.one_liner: AI Cost Management: Track and attribute AI spend across every provider
companies.long_description:
The problem: 
AI has quietly become one of the largest and fastest-growing line items for companies. Spend is scattered across a dozen provider consoles that each show one number at the end of the month and nothing about why it moved. There's no unified view, and no way to trace a dollar back to the customer, feature, team, or even the pull request that caused it.

Which customers are unprofitable once you subtract their AI costs? Which feature is quietly burning your Anthropic budget? Is this week's spike a runaway loop or real growth? How much did that AI-written PR actually cost to ship?
Today teams reverse-engineer answers by exporting CSVs from each provider and stitching them together in a spreadsheet, and by the time they do, the money is already spent.

What SuperPenguin does: SuperPenguin tracks AI spend across 14 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Modal, Cursor, OpenRouter, and more).

* Zero-code setup: connect an API key and costs sync automatically with model-level breakdowns, trends, and forecasts
* Per-request attribution: add two lines with our Python or TypeScript SDK to tag every AI call by customer, feature, team, or environment (or any other metadata).
* AI coding cost per PR: connect Cursor to see engineering spend attributed to each pull request, repo, and developer, so you know what it actually costs to ship.
* Alerts on budget thresholds and spend anomalies, delivered to Slack, email, or Discord.

Most teams are set up in under five minutes. We help companies see where their AI money goes and whether it's worth it.

companies.name: Unifold

companies.long_description:
Launch crypto deposits in minutes. 

Unifold is a developer-first API + SDK that makes it easy for any app to accept on-chain deposits – across any chain and token – with less than 10 lines of code. We handle the full deposit flow so teams can ship faster and give users a smooth experience that actually works.

If you’re building a consumer-facing on-chain product and want best-in-class deposits (or want to support more chains fast), we’d love to work with you.

companies.name: Remix

Instagram was the easiest way to create photos on mobile. Remix is the easiest way to create everything else. Try it for yourself. Download the app and we'll instantly generate content from your LinkedIn and Twitter.

companies.name: Condor Energy

Condor helps large electricity consumers - C&I and data centers - cut electricity costs by helping the grid.

companies.name: Martini

companies.name: Wideframe

companies.long_description:
Wideframe is an AI coworker for video editors. It automates the searching, labeling, organizing, and sequencing of footage so editors can ship videos faster.

Why is this important? Well, it turns out that editors spend 3x more time preparing footage than actually editing.

One agency said we will save their editors 10 hours per week. Another organized an entire documentary worth of footage in hours rather than weeks. He had 2,500+ videos, 500+ audio clips, across >2.5 TB of files and our agent handled them effortlessly.

companies.name: Cardinal

companies.name: Inth

companies.long_description:
Inth brings together consent management, continuous privacy monitoring and AI-assisted investigation. It follows changes from code to production so engineering, marketing and legal teams can see what their sites and codebases are doing, verify their controls and get problems fixed.

We're the team behind c15t, our open-source (Apache-2.0) consent framework with millions of downloads, rebuilt in v3 to run on any framework and on the server. We also maintain an open library of privacy enforcement cases, and we've completed our SOC 2 Type 2 audit.

Rainbrand is the brand layer for agents. It turns a brand’s identity, guidance, and assets into shared context that agents and products can use. That context evolves with the brand, alongside the tools where it is created and managed.

Starting with websites, social media, and files, Rainbrand develops and maintains versioned brand context. Through MCP or the API, connected agents and products can retrieve and update that context, then apply it to images, websites, slides, video, copy, and other brand work.

We’re an ai infra company making brand as operable as software.

companies.name: Dispatch
companies.one_liner: Satellites for Manufacturing in Space
companies.long_description:
Dispatch is building refurbishable reentry vehicles that host and return payloads for companies making ultra-high-value materials (semiconductors, biotech, and pharma) that can only be manufactured in space. Right now, these companies have no practical way to manufacture and get their products back to Earth. We solve this bottleneck.

We just returned from the Mojave Desert testing our first full-scale reentry heat shield designed to protect the satellite as it returns from space at Mach 20+, built in an apartment for 100x cheaper than competitors. To test, we held it behind a rocket engine to simulate the forces of atmospheric reentry. IT WORKED! Watch here - https://youtu.be/dhlQmnIoptg

To scale, we anchor permanent infrastructure in orbit - building high power Autonomous Space Stations designed from day one for "lights-out" manufacturing serviced by the reentry vehicles.

companies.name: Hedge

companies.long_description: Hedge is an AI-Native specialty insurance company. We help insurance brokers find faster, cheaper, and better coverage for their customers.

companies.name: Surtr Defense Systems

companies.long_description: Surtr builds ParallaxOS, the open operating system for counter-UAS. companies.name: Klarify
companies.one_liner: AI Agent for Therapists
companies.long_description:
Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients.

Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. 

Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it.

Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients.

Nearly 12,300 therapists use Klarify today.

Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.

Founded by two alumni of Meta's Superintelligence org: Péter Vajda led Media GenAI foundation-model R&D (Emu, Movie Gen, image and video editing), and Seiji Yamamoto led teams in the Core Llama group across LLM pre-training and post-training, inference optimization, and computer vision. We're early, deliberately quiet about the details, and hiring the first researchers who will shape what this becomes. San Francisco, on-site.

companies.name: Memoir
companies.one_liner: AI in your calls
companies.long_description:
Memoir is an AI teammate that joins your video calls, listens like everyone else, and only talks when you talk to it.

A founder is on a sales call. The customer asks what a pilot would look like. Instead of promising to send something over, the founder says, "Memoir, draft this up." A few seconds later there's a page in the chat with the plan they just talked through. Everyone opens it, and they go through it together before anyone hangs up. Afterward, Memoir can help the founder follow up on what they promised, with one click.

Most calls end with a list of things people said they'd do, and it takes days to do them. Agents already do real work in our email, our browsers and our code. They've become extensions of us. But on calls, most of them still just take notes.

We're starting with technical founders on the sales and design calls they run in Google Meet. But we want every call to work like that one. Eventually everyone will bring their own agents to a call, and those agents will work together the way the people do.

companies.name: Multiplier
companies.one_liner: Agent harnesses for asset managers
companies.long_description:
Multiplier helps institutional investors research stocks and manage their portfolios. We're live with six hedge funds, and our users spend 4+ hours a day in the platform.

Investors who try "nearly every tool on the market," to quote a client of ours, "wind up with an unwieldy collection of fragmented point solutions." Those who focus on building a great setup with general agents are instead "signing up for a full-time job." So we deploy a platform called Multiplier that unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI work, human work, and tacit firm knowledge in one secure, governed, customized application.

Our first vertical: independent equity funds with $250M-$5B of assets. They know AI is essential for staying relevant, but they don't have the time or talent to figure out what to do about it. But once we deploy Multiplier––"We used to spend 80% of our time gathering information and 20% of our time acting on it," said one customer. "Multiplier has flipped those percentages."

Replicas is a cloud coding agent that allows you to delegate tasks to Claude Code or Codex from the app, Slack, Linear, and more. Each task works inside of a sandboxed virtual machine, allowing teams to heavily parallelize work and burn through tickets.

companies.name: Rudus
companies.one_liner: AI Takeoffs for Concrete
companies.long_description: Rudus is an AI-powered takeoff and estimation platform enabling concrete contractors to win 3x more projects yearly. It automatically identifies every concrete structure like footings, walls, columns, and slabs on plans, eliminating the manual work and reducing estimation time by 70%. Concrete is the most-used material on earth after water, and demand is surging with the AI infrastructure boom.

companies.name: Hexa

companies.long_description: Hexa helps industrial distributors automate their sales and procurement workflows to quote faster and win more bids.

companies.name: Scope
companies.one_liner: We help software companies get discovered and used by AI agents
companies.long_description:
Scope is the system companies use to measure and improve how agents discover, interact and use their product.

As more products gets used through AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar agents, agents are starting to influence which tools get chosen, how they get set up, and whether they keep getting used. Most companies still cannot see that process clearly.

We run real workflows across agents and show teams when the agent picks them versus a competitor, where it breaks, where docs or product surfaces confuse the agent, and what to change to get better results and a better agent experience.

I started Scope after working on interpretability research for closed-source models at Princeton and later as an ML engineer in GEO/AEO. I kept seeing the same pattern: these systems were shaping real product discovery and usage, but companies had very little visibility into what the model was actually doing.

We are starting with products that agents can directly interact with, especially APIs, infra products, CLIs, and MCP servers.

companies.name: Twolabs

companies.long_description:

We focus on complex, underexplored domains where high-quality training data is scarce and existing models fall short.

Our long-term goal is to develop self-improving training infrastructure that can autonomously generate increasingly challenging tasks, evaluate performance, and continuously advance model capabilities toward recursive self-improvement.

companies.name: LightSprint

companies.long_description:

The company is founded by Ben Ong, an AI investor who previously scaled AI products at SEA Group (NYSE: SE) and Temasek ($300B fund), Benedict Chan who was VP Engineering at Chainlink and CTO at BitGo (NYSE:BTGO), and Heng Hong Lee who built Facebook Messenger in 2013 and was Director of Engineering at Fazz (YC S17).

companies.name: Discovered Materials
companies.one_liner: AI scientists to discover materials for the semiconductor industry.
companies.long_description:
We use AI to discover new materials for the semiconductor industry - specifically datacenters and fabs. Finding novel materials today takes 10+ years of lab work. We aim to compress that timeline to months, using a swarm of AI agents.

Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. Advaith was the founding applied scientist at Persona AI (acquired by Luma Labs), where he built long horizon autonomous agents for major telecom and crypto companies.

Power consumption and heat release from AI chips is doubling every year. The semiconductor industry needs new materials to keep this exponential going -  Discovered Materials will help find them.

Saffron allows companies to quickly evaluate how well software engineers use AI to code. 

The way engineers write code has fundamentally changed, but the way companies evaluate them hasn't. Saffron gives teams full visibility into how candidates use AI agents to build, debug, and ship real features on an actual codebase. 

Saffron was founded by Robert Chondro (formerly MIT and Jane Street), Jerry Yao (Stanford and Jane Street), and Kazuma Choji (Harvey Mudd, published in NeurIPS and ICML), and is backed by Y Combinator (P26) and Afore Capital.

companies.name: InLoop Robotics

Warehouses without human labor that get better, faster, and cheaper with every order.

Most robotics companies wait until their system is perfect before deploying. We don't. We ship imperfect policies into real warehouses, detect failures in real time, recover automatically when we can, and bring in a remote human operator when we can't.

Every failure becomes training data. Every intervention makes the system better. The result is a fulfillment system that continuously learns from production.

companies.name: Dayjob

Customers in waste management see 8%+ efficiency gains from day one.

companies.name: Trellis

companies.long_description:
Trellis is building toward a new hospitality platform: one that does not just help guests find homes, but actually operates them with agents. 

Our first wedge is short-term rental property managers, replacing their fragmented stack across guest messages, tasks, cleaners, maintenance, vendors, and owner updates with agents that run operations end-to-end. 

In two months, we’ve grown to $500k ARR across 35 customers and 3000 listings, growing around 15% week over week, with one customer already running day-to-day operations with no human involved.

Consumer brands have always been limited by the speed of humans: hiring, coordinating, and sleeping. AI agents that now run operations end-to-end break all those constraints, making a new kind of consumer business possible: one capped by compute, not headcount.

Today, Light Anchor operates 7 brands, all run by AI agents on a shared platform that compounds with every new brand launched. The vision is thousands of consumer businesses, operating with little to no human intervention.

companies.name: Limrun

We are on a mission to cloudify every local development utility so that regardless of where it runs, your agent can compose an ideal set of capabilities on the fly so you don't need to run it on your laptop.

Today, we provide remote services such as XCode, iOS & Android simulators to enable coding agents running in any sandbox to be able to build and iterate over mobile apps, too.

Replit, Rork, Momentic, Minitap and more agent companies have built mobile development and testing experiences on Limrun platform. Coconote (Quizlet), SorceJobs (W25) and more companies with mobile apps use Limrun with their cloud agents, merging PRs without having to check out the code locally.

companies.name: Superlog
companies.one_liner: Make software self-healing
companies.long_description:
Sentry and Datadog dump a stream of alerts. Most are duplicates, most lack context, and you still have to solve the issue yourself.

Superlog is AI-native observability that's meant not to be opened. A wizard scans your repo and installs proper OpenTelemetry instrumentation, then runs daily to keep up as you ship new code. When something breaks, Superlog groups the errors into a single incident, investigates with full context (logs, traces, recent deploys, past Slack threads), and posts one mergeable PR in Slack. You merge it, ignore it, or open it as a Claude Code session and modify it.

Telemetry is vendor-neutral, so you keep every log, trace, and metric we install, even if you leave.

companies.name: GovGuard

companies.long_description:
GovGuard is building AI agents that automate government workflows, starting with FOIA requests.

Today, public records teams still spend hours searching for responsive records and applying redactions. Many offices still redact sensitive information line by line with a sharpie. Local governments spend billions processing these requests, and if a city misses a legal deadline, it can be sued for failing to comply with public records law.

companies.name: Elyra

Elyra is an AI reservation system for restaurants. Felix and Alan met in primary school in Stockholm and have been building things together ever since.

We launched with a single restaurant and within weeks they hit record occupancy, bookings they used to miss were suddenly being captured automatically, and empty Tuesday nights started filling up. Today we power top restaurants groups. 

There are over 1 million restaurants in the US and Europe alone. The average restaurant loses $100K+ a year to missed calls and slow email replies. At our current pricing, that's a $10B+ market opportunity, and we're the only system that handles the call, the email, and the table allocation in one place.

companies.name: KelAI

Investment teams now have more data, tools and compute than ever, but research still runs across siloed systems and inefficient workflows. KelAI turns that fragmented process into a compounding AI-native engine that continuously finds, tests and validates trading signals at a pace no human team can match.

companies.long_description: BayMachines deploys on-prem, air-gapped GPU containers for defense teams to run and fine-tune AI locally. We support defense technology companies serving the DoW and special operations, with deployments built to support CMMC and NIST 800-171 requirements.

companies.name: Pavoot

companies.long_description:
Pavoot is an AI event manager for companies that run in-person customer events.

More and more companies are investing in dinners, summits, and community events because relationships drive revenue. But today, running events means sourcing attendees, sending invitations, hosting the event, and then manually digging through notes, emails, and spreadsheets afterward to figure out who attended, what was discussed, who is a strong lead, and who should be followed up with. Most teams either send generic "thanks for coming" emails or never properly capture the value created during the event.

Pavoot replaces this fragmented workflow with a single AI system that keeps every attendee, interaction, conversation, and follow-up connected in one place, making relationship-driven growth scalable.

Gohar and Ana met while studying Computer Science at ETH Zurich. Gohar is a six-time Swiss chess champion and was the youngest member of Switzerland’s national chess team at age 13. Ana won more than 20 medals in scientific Olympiads, ranked 1st in CS at Latin America’s most competitive university, and built internal AI systems used by hundreds of data scientists at some of the largest banks in Latin America before moving to ETH Zurich for AI research.

===

Book a demo: pavoot.com

companies.long_description: Madrone builds cooling systems for data centers. In Texas, where most new sites are, Madrone can cool using 30% less power and water, thanks to novel dew-point cooling technology.

companies.name: Standout

companies.long_description:
Standout gives every talent and company an autonomous agent that represents them, assess the other side, and makes intros when it matters.

Why it matters? Because this is hiring today:
- Talent use AI to apply to 100s of jobs - this is spam.
- Founders/Recruiting send 100s of AI-generated messages to hire the same talent - this is spam.

This has to stop.

Talent stays fully anonymous until they accept an intro. The best way for passively exploring the market and not missing a life changing opportunity.

In 1 month, 10k talent / 60 companies / 100 intros.

companies.name: transload

transload helps logistics companies measure shipments using the security cameras they already have. A pallet, a couch, a tire – we capture its true size as it moves through the warehouse.

For our customers, 15% of shipments turn out to be bigger than what the sender claimed. Catching those differences is worth ~$50k per site per month in rebillings and improved trailer utilization.

companies.name: Userlens

companies.long_description:
Companies today are growing faster than ever with smaller teams. The best AI-native companies don’t just need more users - they need more of their users becoming power users. Userlens makes it possible for lean teams to drive product adoption proactively, at scale.

Userlens is building the AI product adoption expert. Our goal is to help every user at every company get more value from the product they already use.

Most teams still rely on onboarding flows, lifecycle emails, support docs, and reactive CSM outreach. Userlens breaks that ceiling. Lumi watches how users actually use your product, spots when they’re ready for the next feature, workflow, or habit, and nudges them at exactly the right moment.

companies.name: Sherpa

Sherpa automatically optimizes websites for every human and every agent. For AI agents, Sherpa tests different agent-facing versions of the site until agents recommend the company more often. 

Customers typically see a 15-20% lift in their primary conversion metric after using Sherpa for 30 days.

companies.name: Antinuous

companies.long_description:
Antinuous is building autonomous research agents to help people in research, development, discovery, and knowledge work do faster, more accurate research end to end without a human in the loop.

We believe humans should be able to ask a single question, and no matter how simple or complex, agents should look at the question, break it down, research the answer, test new ideas, simulate new environments, and repeat autonomously using as much or little compute as necessary elastically.

companies.long_description:
InstaAgent helps B2C companies scale a single campaign across hundreds of specific audiences on Meta and TikTok, each with its own content, voice, and targeting. Traction: $1M Ann. Run Rate in 10 months.

From one brief, we create personalized creatives, distribute them through paid channels and niche social accounts, and use performance data to learn what works, scale winners, and improve every campaign.

companies.long_description: Our agents retrieve and synthesize all the records law firms need to start a personal injury case. We get police reports, open insurance claims, and retrieve all the medical records and bills needed to build a case.

We build environments to test your app and agents against the real world.

Twins support the same APIs, MCP tool calls & SDKs as the real software, and you can spin up thousands of instances in parallel and seed them using natural language. Synphony's "side hustle" is selling data, evals, and viral demos to robot foundation labs while building capacity for general robot deployments. We've started with strawberry farming for great margins and outdoor data moat, but also received requests for robots in semi-conductors and autonomous space labs. 

Synphony's team has won over 15 hackathons together (taking home 4 Jensen-signed GPUs!). Sean did ML research at NVIDIA and led AI products used by IRS and Citibank. Lucas' research spanned robotics, IoT devices, and neuromorphic computing. Alex architected an app with 400k users.

companies.name: Callab AI
companies.one_liner: Human-centered AI for contact centers.
companies.long_description:
Callab AI is a human-centered customer engagement platform for enterprise contact centers. It lets teams deploy AI agents that handle inbound and outbound conversations across voice, chat, and messaging, while human agents and supervisors stay in control of every interaction.

The platform has two sides. The AI side lets teams build, deploy, and evaluate voice and text agents using a shared knowledge base, embedded evaluations, post-call analysis, data extraction, batch calling, and call transfer. The human side provides a dialer and a live supervision dashboard, from which a person can watch any AI conversation in real time, step in, and hand it back without the customer repeating a word.

Every agent retains memory across channels, so a customer who called yesterday and writes today is recognized and picked up where they left off. The system learns from each human intervention and improves in the direction the team chooses.

Callab AI runs on its own carrier-grade telephony stack and connects natively to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX systems. Enterprises can adopt it without migrating to the cloud first. The platform maintains SOC 2 controls and serves customers in financial services, healthcare, hospitality, and retail.

Key features:

- AI voice and text agents: Agents handle inbound and outbound conversations across phone, chat, and messaging from a single configuration.

- Live human supervision: Supervisors watch any AI conversation in real time and take over without the customer repeating a word.

- Persistent memory: Every customer's full context is retained across channels and over time.

- AI builder: Teams design, test, and deploy agents without engineering support.

- Embedded evaluations: Every conversation is scored continuously, so performance is measured rather than assumed.

- Self-improving agents: Agents learn from human interventions and get better with every conversation.

- Post-call analysis and data extraction: Every conversation becomes structured, searchable records.

- Batch calling and call transfer: Outbound campaigns run at scale, and conversations move to a human with full context attached.

- Native telephony integration: The platform connects directly to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX without cloud migration.

- SOC 2 controls: Security and compliance support deployments in regulated industries.

Callab AI delivers every agent production-ready. Our team studies the customer's workflows, internal processes, and existing systems, then builds, tests, and implements the agent on that foundation, so it performs to the organization's own standard from the first live conversation.

companies.name: Pairio
companies.one_liner: AI mobile app that helps factory technicians fix broken machines
companies.long_description: Pairio is an AI mobile app to help technicians fix broken equipment in factories. Users just take a picture of the broken machine and we search thousands of pages of manuals to find the right solution.

companies.name: Taiga
companies.one_liner: Autonomous medical billing
companies.long_description:
Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork.                                                       
                                                                                                                        
We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them. We want providers to treat patients while we handle the rest.

companies.name: StableBrowse
companies.one_liner: Building the Data Infrastructure layer for Physical AI.

companies.name: Kimpton
companies.one_liner: Live Evaluation Arenas for Financial Work
companies.long_description:
In investment management, every decision gets graded. The market prints the answer on a date known in advance, and nobody gets to argue with it.

Kimpton is financial AI that answers to reality. Kimpton OS is the AI-native operating system for investment teams: it does the research and hands PMs structured trades. EarningsBench is a public benchmark where models forecast quarterly earnings before companies report and the reported numbers do the scoring. Koliseum is the set of point-in-time financial environments we build from that work, for labs to train and evaluate models on.

The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding into passive. AI was supposed to fix that, but it hasn't. Funds either stitch together a dozen point tools or babysit general agents all day, and neither gets them to the trade.

Kimpton OS goes straight to it. It ingests a fund's mandate, strategy, and positions, connects to the institutional data the fund already runs on, and returns a structured trade proposal built for that fund. It's built to disagree, because consensus is poison for investment decisions. Instead of telling a PM what they want to hear, it surfaces the breaches and risks they'd otherwise miss.

That same work is how we grade AI. Static benchmarks leak into training data. Simulations reward what their authors imagined. A forecast sealed before the outcome exists and scored when the company reports can't be rehearsed or backdated. We started in markets because they're the one place reality answers on schedule.

We're two ex-Goldman engineers and an ex-SpaceX engineer. We left to start our own quantitative systematic hedge fund, raised $10M from a family office at 21 and 22, and scaled it to $35M over four years. We learned to trust live results over historical fit. We built Kimpton inside that fund, then productized the stack.

We're live with our first institutional client, a $3.3B manager. Our first market is fundamental equity funds from $1B to $10B, and the labs that need to know whether their models can do this work.
companies.all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote

companies.name: Lamina Labs
companies.one_liner: Near-real-time video infrastructure for LLMs
companies.long_description:
Lamina Labs is building infrastructure for near-real-time structured video generation.

Most AI video is built for cinematic clips. Lamina is built for useful videos that break down ideas, workflows, and AI answers. Our first product, Simi, turns prompts and documents into whiteboard-style explainer videos in seconds

companies.name: BentoLabs AI
companies.one_liner: Monitoring and learning layer for long-running agents
companies.long_description:
BentoLabs is the monitoring and learning layer for long-running agents. We detect when agents silently fail or drift from the user's goal, system prompt, or tool contracts, show affected users and root cause, and suggest the prompt, skill, or harness fix.

As more teams deploy agents, keeping them reliable in production becomes mission-critical. Bento sits directly in the production loop and gives teams the operational leverage required to scale agent ecosystems without scaling human firefighting alongside them. The result is a system that turns opaque agents into agents that can be monitored, debugged, and improved continuously.

The founders learned this problem at Emergent (YC S24), where they built and operated production coding agents used by 5M+ users. Abhinav was hire #1 and helped Emergent hit SWE-Bench #1 and scale from $0 to $100M ARR in just 8 months. Kaushik was hire #2, led full-stack engineering at Emergent, and was key to building the infrastructure that made production agents reliable, observable, and debuggable. Bento's self-learning engine has also lifted ARC-AGI-3 (internal) by 2.6x and Terminal-Bench 2.0 (internal) from 42.2% to 52.4% pass@1 with the same model, tools, and budget.

companies.name: Lab0
companies.one_liner: AI FDEs to make your B2B SaaS Go Live in Days, not Months
companies.long_description:
Enterprise software implementation is broken,  and it has been for decades. 
Every rollout, whether it's a traditional ERP or a new AI system, requires months of manual integration, configuration, and tuning done by armies of system integrators and forward-deployed engineers. 
Lab0 builds agentic systems that automate this layer, compressing months-long implementations into weeks.

companies.name: Gojiberry AI
companies.one_liner: AI Go-To-Market agents for B2B teams
companies.long_description:
Gojiberry is building the AI GTM team for B2B companies.

We start with outbound: Gojiberry finds buyers showing intent, enriches them, reaches out, follows up, handles replies, and books qualified meetings.

Companies use Gojiberry to replace the old way of doing outbound: buying tools, hiring SDRs & agencies, testing lists, writing messages, and guessing what works. Gojiberry turns it into one AI team that finds buyers and books meetings.

Every campaign makes Gojiberry smarter. It learns which buyers convert, which signals matter, which messages get replies, and which actions create revenue. Over time, Gojiberry uses what works across similar companies and industries to help every new customer get better results from day one.

Long term, Gojiberry will become the system that finds every revenue opportunity and acts on it: outbound leads, website visitors, inbound leads, old CRM leads, replies, meetings, CRM updates, new campaign ideas, and account expansion.

The goal is to make every B2B company able to run a high-performing GTM team without hiring one.

We grew from $0 to $2.5M ARR in 10 months, are growing 30% MoM, profitable, and used by 2,000+ customers.

Customers get 2-5x more positive replies than traditional outbound.

companies.long_description: For companies that want to 10x, Echo agents learn the work, do it end to end, and scale it

companies.name: Ontora

companies.long_description: Ontora is an AI Agent that interviews every employee to map how work actually gets done and identify bottlenecks. Consultants spend months doing this manually; Ontora does it in hours.

companies.name: Oddpool

companies.long_description:
Oddpool is a platform that helps quant funds and trading desks harness the power of prediction markets.

Avi and Ritesh have been roommates since freshman year at Georgia Tech. Avi has a Master's in ML and saved Microsoft $6M/year by building a more accurate model on half the hardware. Ritesh has a Master's in Distributed Systems and made buy-side trading systems at Bloomberg 40% faster.

companies.name: Voquill
companies.one_liner: The agentic OS for medical labs
companies.long_description:
Voquill is the modern AI-native operating system for medical labs. This software manages the entire workflow of the lab (accessioning, workflow, reporting, coding, compliance, and revenue) and contains modern agentic AI tools to help each step. For example, pathologists can write reports 20% faster through our voice AI coworker.

Incumbent lab operating systems are old, don't scale with how modern labs work, and can’t integrate existing AI solutions. As a result, labs are either building their own or paying millions for band-aid solutions and consultants. We're building an agentic platform to manage every aspect of the lab and displace the billions spent on legacy management systems.

companies.name: Keyframe Labs

companies.long_description: We build human foundation models. Our first family of models powers lifelike avatars that interact with users in real time, enabling AI agents and applications to go beyond text and voice with just a few lines of code. State-of-the-art realism with ultra-low latency at scale.

companies.name: Savant
companies.one_liner: Company brain every AI-native enterprise runs on
companies.long_description: Savant is the company brain every AI-native enterprise runs on. We plug into the tools you already use, capture the written knowledge / undocumented procedures, and serve them to your employees and agents at decision time.

companies.name: Adialante
companies.one_liner: Cancer screening without barriers
companies.long_description:
We know how to improve cancer outcomes by 8x-10x: you catch it early. 

MRI is the most robust and powerful cancer-detection tool in the world, yet systems cost millions to purchase, take months to install, and require high levels of technical skill to operate. We've redesigned MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware, all to bring cancer screening to the entire world. 

Our mobile MRI is an imaging clinic on wheels. No equipment to buy, no infrastructure needed. For a flat per-scan fee, any medical site can offer MRI cancer screening. Starting with prostate cancer. Then everything else.

companies.name: Lumius
companies.one_liner: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound that anyone can use
companies.long_description:
Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much.

Lumius is building fast, smart, and accessible 3D ultrasound systems to eliminate this 2D guesswork. Our technology shows a clear, real-time 3D view of what’s inside the body. It works over a large volume, not just a thin slice. The device is also affordable, compact, and portable.

We are starting with vascular access, especially central line. Future use cases include blood clot detection, tumor diagnosis, and biopsy guidance. Our long-term vision is a universal 3D ultrasound platform that brings easy-to-use, real-time imaging to a wide range of clinical and eventually consumer applications.

companies.name: Prototyping.io
companies.one_liner: Autonomous manufacturing for mechanical parts
companies.long_description: Prototyping.io turns CAD designs into real mechanical parts through an AI-driven manufacturing system. We analyze designs for manufacturability and automate production workflows to deliver high-quality parts faster and at lower cost.

companies.name: Result
companies.one_liner: Where new internet entrepreneurs build and run their companies
companies.long_description: Result is where the next generation of founders start and run their companies. companies.name: Parrot

companies.long_description: Parrot is an agentic OS that understands your business so it can call, negotiate, and coordinate with real humans.
